cost_per_open.name: ZB-014 key
cost_per_open.opens: The locked grate door inside the ZB-014 bunker, which contains a 5x5 weapon box and the ZB-014 PMC extraction
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Far west / south-west of Woods, against the western map border. From the sawmill head south to the big lake, then west with the lake on your left, continue to the large cliff face and follow it until you see a white fence - the concrete bunker is sunk into the ground along that fence, roughly north of the Scav House extract and south of the Power Line Passage flare zone. Go down the entrance stairs; the locked grate door is at the bottom inside the bunker. Thick green smoke behind the door means the exfil is live; with no smoke the door still opens, you just cannot extract. Watch the rocks nearby, known camping spot.
cost_per_open.value_note: 40 uses makes it cheap per raid, but there is only a single 5x5 weapon box behind the door - buy it for the Aid Stations handover and a guaranteed PMC exfil in the dead west of the map, not for loot.

cost_per_open.name: Trailer park portable cabin key
cost_per_open.opens: A portable on-site guard cabin at the trailer park
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Trailer park on the west side of the river - the portable guard cabin at the park itself (distinct from the cabin next to it that the Portable cabin key opens).
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key. It lost its Golden Swag quest role after 1.0 and has no documented loot, and Therapist pays 3,369 RUB for it - more than the flea asks. When the vendor price beats the market price, the market has written the item off.

cost_per_open.name: Factory emergency exit key
cost_per_open.opens: Three locks on Factory: the Med Tent Gate PMC extraction door, the Cellars PMC extraction door in the underground, and the locked room on the 3rd floor of the office area. Off-map bonus: the ZB-013 extraction door in the Scav base basement on Customs, plus both doors of the crane yard guard building next to the new gas station on Customs.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: MED TENT GATE: south-east outdoor corner of the map. Take the corridors running south/left out of the Forklift area, or head straight east from the Gate 0 side. Look for the large, brightly lit medical tent with a transformer and a big box beside it; you can walk through the tent or round it on either side. Open the red metal door behind the tent, then a second red door inside it. CELLARS: down in the underground cellar level that links the four workshops, taking the tunnels east of the generators; this is the flooded/tunnel network reached by the floor holes and stairwells. LOCKED OFFICE ROOM: central multi-storey office block (the structure with the stairwells overlooking the workshop floors) - go to the top, 3rd floor, and it is the single locked door on the landing next to the office. This is the 'conspiracy theorist's room' from Is This a Reference?.
cost_per_open.value_note: The room behind it is near-worthless (a jacket and a cheap Customs key), so this is an EXIT and QUEST key, not a loot key - at ~P250-350k for 20 uses it is about P15k a raid to own two extra PMC exfils on a 20-minute map plus a Customs ZB-013 exit, which is what makes it pay, and it is secure-container safe so you keep it on death.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 103 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 103 on the first floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, first floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 138 RUB per open and it is a food cupboard - only worth it if you are levelling Metabolism or stocking the hideout.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 323 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 323 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor, room 323. Door is open; there is a weapon cabinet inside worth a look.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key. Loot the weapon cabinet on your way past 3F west, but the key itself does nothing.

cost_per_open.name: Underground parking utility room key
cost_per_open.opens: The utility/plant room door off the underground parking level, marked on the wiki interactive map as "Underground Parking Utility Room" under the Locked category. The room has a second exit: a heavy blast door with a red wheel-valve leading to a stairwell that runs back up to street level, so it is a through-route as well as a loot room.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground level, in the parking/loading branch of the underground corridor network near the Skyside (Area 2) stairwell — the western half of the underground, reachable from the surface by the vehicle ramp that drops down into the parking deck. Drive/run down the ramp; the ramp has a raised pedestrian walkway on the left-hand (building) side. As the ramp bottoms out onto the parking level, look at that left wall: it is black-tiled and carries two red-and-white Russian signs, "ВНИМАНИЕ! ОБЪЕКТ ОХРАНЯЕТСЯ / ВЕДЁТСЯ ВИДЕОНАБЛЮДЕНИЕ" (CCTV warning) above "ПОСТОРОННИМ ВХОД ВОСПРЕЩЁН" (no unauthorised entry). Directly under those signs a short flight of concrete steps with a metal handrail drops into a sunken stairwell. The plain grey metal door at the bottom of those steps is the utility room. There is a raised loading walkway stacked with cardboard boxes on your right as you face the steps, and pickup trucks/vans parked behind a chain-link fence beyond it.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheapest genuinely good keyed room in the game right now — six containers including a toolbox, a grenade box and two weapon boxes for ~160₽ per open, in a low-traffic underground room with a second exit; it pays for itself on the first raid and 39 times over after that.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PP key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing. The wiki states plainly: "This key does currently not open any lock." Its description references a Radar Station bomb shelter that has never been implemented.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: There is no door. The wiki Lock Location section reads "None."
cost_per_open.value_note: Opens zero doors. Sell it to Therapist for 2,550 the moment you find one, and never barter for it at Jaeger.

cost_per_open.name: Unity Credit Bank cash register key
cost_per_open.opens: Customer desk booth no. 2 inside the Tarbank branch. Marked on the wiki interactive map as "Tarbank Cash Register Booth" under the Locked category. Despite the item name referencing Unity Credit, the door it opens is in the Tarbank on Ground Zero — do not confuse this with the Streets of Tarkov "Tarbank cash register department key".
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The Tarbank is tenant no. 1 of the Empire business centre (Area 5), on the west face of the Empire block facing ул. Норвинская (Norvinskaya Street), just south of the ул. Торговый ряд junction and directly across the street from the Fusion block / "Coffie Vice" corner. It sits roughly map-centre, west-southwest of the TerraGroup complex and south-west of the Police Cordon V-Ex. Go in through the Tarbank customer hall, then into the staff corridor behind the teller line — a plain white corridor with a dark grey wainscot stripe running along the walls. Booth 2's door is on the right-hand side of that corridor, the middle door of the run; further down the corridor on the left there is an open doorway with cardboard boxes stacked in it, which is a good landmark. Inside is a single tiny teller cubicle: desk with monitor, keyboard, mouse and a desk phone, a wooden-framed glazed serving window onto the customer hall, a combination safe built in under the counter on the left, and a three-drawer filing unit with a printer on top to the right.
cost_per_open.value_note: A safe plus a drawer plus loose cash for well under 300₽ a pop is clearly profitable, but the Tarbank sits in the busiest street corridor on the map, so the risk premium — not the rouble cost — is what you are actually paying.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 203 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 203 on the second floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, second floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 194 RUB per open, but the room is literally two sports bags - buy it for Shaking Up the Teller and because it is nearly free, not for the loot.

cost_per_open.name: Stair landing key
cost_per_open.opens: The door to the eastern staircase on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Chekannaya 15. Same brutal route as the Chekannaya 15 apartment key: hole in the exterior wall, western staircase, third floor, drop through the hole in cell #5's floor, prone under the second-floor debris. The eastern staircase door is on that second-floor hallway.
cost_per_open.value_note: Zero loot. It is a movement shortcut out of Chekannaya 15 and nothing else. Only carry one if you are farming that building repeatedly and value the exit.

cost_per_open.name: Old house room key
cost_per_open.opens: A locked room in the old house at the train depot on Woods
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Same building as the toilet key, far south-east of the map at the train depot: the small old house with semi-circle windows, ~2 m from the toilet door (the room door is the north-west one of the pair). Two buried barrel caches sit within about 10-15 m of the house and a Scav spawn is ~25 m away. Route in is the BTR to the Train Depot stop; the street out front is in border-sniper reach, so stay tight to the wall.
cost_per_open.value_note: At ~90k for 10 uses it pays back on the first trip in hideout materials alone, and the BTR-gated depot is one of the least contested loot spots in the game.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup storage room keycard
cost_per_open.opens: The door to the TerraGroup storage room (the 'TerraGroup warehouse') in the Factory underground - the only genuine loot room on the map.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground tunnel level. Drop into the cellars/tunnels and navigate to the 'Camera Bunker Door' Scav extraction; the keycard door sits immediately next to that Scav exfil. If you are extracting Camera Bunker Door as a Scav you are already standing next to it.
cost_per_open.value_note: At ~P2.5-3M for 10 uses that is P250-300k per entry, and the room only clears that if you hit the LEDX, the Bitcoin, or a good roll out of the two TerraGroup safes - do Dragnet and The Unheard, then sell it; farming it free off night-Factory Cultists is the only version of this that is clearly profitable.

cost_per_open.name: Yotota car key
cost_per_open.opens: The door of the blue Yotota pickup truck at the sawmill - but the lock is bugged and cannot be opened
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Sawmill / lumber-camp side, next to the wooden shacks about 20 m north-east of Shturman's stash. The blue Yotota pickup is parked beside the cabins - the cabin closest to the truck is the one holding the Health Resort east wing room 308 key on the nightstand. Worth walking past for the cabin loot; the truck itself is a dead end.
cost_per_open.value_note: Do not buy at any price - the truck door is bugged shut and the wiki does not even know what is inside; sell any you loot.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 108 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 108 on the first floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, first floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 238 RUB per open for a PC block and some cash - marginal, but it is on the ground floor so the detour is a few seconds.

cost_per_open.name: RB-AK key
cost_per_open.opens: The Educational Building (School / Black Bishop) storage room
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The School / Educational Building marked with a black bishop, in front of the parked helicopter. Take the west-side staircase to the 2nd floor; the storage room door is at the top on that side. Bypass: you can also reach the room with no key at all by dropping from a 3rd-floor window onto the door awning and climbing in through the room's window.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two PC blocks, a Virtex and a Golden 1GPhone for under 250 roubles a use is absurd value - just know the window jump gets you in free, so it buys convenience not access.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 206 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 206 on the second floor of the two-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-storey dorms, second floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 250 RUB per open, but the room is a water cupboard - buy it for Operation Aquarius, hand in, then leave it in the stash. Water items are tucked between, inside and on top of the wooden crates.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 220 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 220 on the second floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, second floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 250 RUB per open; the loot is thin but it is the only source of the ZB-014 key and it clears two Chemical quest steps - and there are four free spawn points, so do not pay flea prices twice.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 322 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 322 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, room 322. Door is open.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key with no loot behind it; the market has mostly figured this one out, hence the 10k price. Still zero reason to own it.

cost_per_open.name: "Negotiation" room key
cost_per_open.opens: The negotiation room (middle office) inside the Zmeisky 6 building - the "game developer office"
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Zmeisky 6 office building (the dev-office building used for Corporate Perks / Developer's Secrets). Enter the building and go to the middle office on the office floor; the negotiation room door is off that middle office.
cost_per_open.value_note: The single best ruble-for-ruble key on the map: ~₽11k, 40 uses, a Medbag SMU06 + PC block + COFDM behind it, and it hands you the Relaxation room key spawn for free.

cost_per_open.name: Power substation utility cabin key
cost_per_open.opens: The utility cabin at the power substation next to the mall.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Outside, NORTH-EAST of the mall: the fenced electrical substation compound beside the power station and the Powerstation V-Ex. The cabin is the small prefab shack inside that compound - a short detour from the power switch you already have to flip, which is what makes this key worth its price. No power required to open it.
cost_per_open.value_note: 250 roubles per use for a 4x4 weapon box, a wooden crate and a shotgun, on a route you were already walking - the cheapest positive-expected-value key on Interchange, with the caveat that the loot list is pre-rework.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 207 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 207 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, room 207. Door is open.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key, no loot documented. Correctly priced near the floor, and still not worth 12k.

cost_per_open.name: Construction site bunkhouse key
cost_per_open.opens: The second floor of the bunkhouse (site cabin) at the construction site
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Construction site by the Collapsed Crane extract. Climb the external stairs of the two-storey bunkhouse/site cabin; the locked door is the second-floor door.
cost_per_open.value_note: A named LEDX spawn plus a Medcase and two jackets for pocket change over 40 uses. Buy it any time it is under ~₽60k.

cost_per_open.name: Portable bunkhouse key
cost_per_open.opens: The second-storey portable cabin between the bus depot and the construction area
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Construction/factory zone - the stacked portable cabins across from the bus depot; the door is on the upper cabin, reached by the external stairs.
cost_per_open.value_note: 309 RUB per open, the cheapest weapon-box key on the map - grab it if your route already goes past the bus depot, ignore it otherwise.

cost_per_open.name: RB-RH key
cost_per_open.opens: The Airspace Control Center security room
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: White King building, 3rd floor. Route 1: up the stairs past the grate door, at the 3rd floor u-turn right, head down the hallway, then turn right. Route 2: up the flight of metal stairs from the White King server room.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dirt cheap but the room is a rack, a gun and two drawers - only worth the slot if you already loop the King building every raid.

cost_per_open.name: Police truck cabin key
cost_per_open.opens: The cabin of the abandoned police transport truck
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Central-west, on the road just WEST of the water treatment plant (map pos ~[922, 2578], ~238 units north of the WTP's southern AGS-30 emplacement and ~250 units north-east of the Scav Hideout at the Grotto scav extract). The truck sits on the roadside; the locked cabin door is the driver's side. The Rogue USEC stash cabin is only ~75 units away, so run both together.
cost_per_open.value_note: 317 rub per open for a guaranteed-slot Intelligence folder plus an AK-103, and it takes five seconds — the cheapest genuine profit on the map.

cost_per_open.name: USEC cottage room key
cost_per_open.opens: A room on the second floor of the garage at the blue chalet (USEC cottages)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East side of the map, mid-map, chalet hill (map pos ~[1931, 1543], ~204 units south-east of the Path to Shoreline extract, ~165 units east of the first USEC safe). It is the second floor of the blue chalet's GARAGE, not the chalet itself. Do not buy this key: you can climb onto the canopy from any second-floor window and enter the room through its window, no key required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key: the room is free through the window, the loot is only loose valuables and currency, and its one quest no longer exists — paying anything for it is a mistake.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 204 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 204 on the second floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, second floor, on the opposite side of the corridor from room 214.
cost_per_open.value_note: 319 RUB per open for a weapon locker and safe combo - solid filler if you are already on the second floor for 214.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 209 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 209 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, room 209. Door is open. Its balcony also connects to 213, which is likewise permanently unlocked, so the whole pair is a free walk-in.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key - but do put 209/213 on your 2F east route, because the rare spawn and three loot containers are now free.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 214 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 214 on the second floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, second floor at the northern end of the corridor. Fastest route is the external stairs on the north side of the building.
cost_per_open.value_note: 338 RUB per open for a safe, and Therapist buys the key back at 13,597 RUB - above the flea ask - so this key is effectively free to own.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 104 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 104 on the first floor of the two-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-storey dorms, first floor, inside the fenced-off section - you cannot reach it from the internal corridor, you have to come in from outside via the first-floor north door.
cost_per_open.value_note: 350 RUB per open for a toolbox and two jackets - technically positive, but the outside-entry detour makes it a waste of raid time.

cost_per_open.name: RB-OP key
cost_per_open.opens: The Airspace Control Center bunker command office
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Bunker / basement level of the Airspace Control Center (White King). Take the staircase down into the bunker; past the open doorway is the locked command office door.
cost_per_open.value_note: 360 roubles a use for an intel folder spawn plus loose valuables - the cheapest reliable intel room on Reserve.

cost_per_open.name: Tarcone Director's office key
cost_per_open.opens: The Tarcone director's administrative office on the upper level of the eastern red Paradigm warehouse ("Big Red")
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Inside "Big Red", the large red Paradigm warehouse - go to the eastern end and up the internal staircase; the office door is at the top of the stairs on the second level. The inner second room is NOT keyed - that door has to be breached.
cost_per_open.value_note: 375 RUB per open, five free spawn points, an Intelligence folder plus three PC blocks and a safe, and it gates two mandatory quests - buy it at 15k without thinking.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 325 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 325 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor, room 325. Door is open. Still worth entering for the Blue keycard spawn.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key. Add 325 to your 3F west keycard-checking loop alongside 303 and 311, and never pay for it.

cost_per_open.name: Zmeisky 3 apartment 8 key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 8 on the second floor of the Zmeisky 3 building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Zmeisky 3. Entrance is on the BACKYARD side. Take the staircase to the second floor; apartment 8's door is on that landing.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheap enough to be harmless at ₽16k, but a sports bag and a jacket is a filler door. Buy only if you already run the Zmeisky block.

cost_per_open.name: Water treatment plant storage room key
cost_per_open.opens: The storage room on the first floor of office building #2 at the water treatment plant
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Water treatment plant, north of the map (map pos ~[1341, 2953], ~121 units south-west of the Industrial Zone Gates scav extract). Office building #2 is the northern/central WTP office block. Get to the first floor and go to the SOUTHEAST corner of the building — the storage room door is there. Warning: a Goons boss spawn is only ~48 map units from this door.
cost_per_open.value_note: At the ~17k low offer that is 425 rub per open for a Technical supply crate plus a Bitcoin spawn — the single best-value key on Lighthouse if you catch a cheap listing.

cost_per_open.name: RB-MP13 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the Service and Repair Center workshop rooms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: 1st floor of the repair point building marked with a white chess knight (the wiki calls it the eastern repair point). The door is off the corridor near the wooden crates.
cost_per_open.value_note: 445 roubles a use for an intel folder and a 6-STEN - one of the best cheap keys on the map if you are already looting the repair buildings.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm guard desk key
cost_per_open.opens: The guard desk room on the first floor of the two-storey dorms, which contains the map's key cabinet
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-storey dorms, ground floor, immediately to the right of the front entrance. Single locked door off the entrance hall.
cost_per_open.value_note: 475 RUB per open for a room that can roll the marked key plus eleven other Customs keys - the single best-value key on the map and it pays for itself the first time the cabinet rolls anything above 20k.

cost_per_open.name: Portable cabin key
cost_per_open.opens: The portable on-site customs control guard cabin next to the trailer park
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West side of the river by the trailer park - the standalone portable guard cabin next to it (not the same cabin as the Trailer park portable cabin key).
cost_per_open.value_note: 475 RUB per open for three jackets - a jacket-farming key, nothing more. tarkov-market's door data hints the Trailer park key may now cover this cabin too; unverified, do not count on it.

cost_per_open.name: RB-MP22 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the Service and Repair Center workshop rooms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: 2nd floor of the repair point building marked with a white knight (the wiki text says Western Repair Point, which conflicts with its other pages - go by the painted chess piece on the wall).
cost_per_open.value_note: Up to three toolboxes and two weapon racks for 480 a use, and the trader buys it back for 14,800 - almost impossible to lose money on.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 105 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 105 on the first floor of the two-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-storey dorms, first floor, southern part of the fenced-off section - that section cannot be reached from the internal corridor, you have to enter from outside through the first-floor north door.
cost_per_open.value_note: 499 RUB per open for a safe - fine value, but the fenced-section detour costs you more time than the safe is usually worth.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 315 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 315 on the third floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, third floor, next door to the marked room 314.
cost_per_open.value_note: 500 RUB per open for a SCAR-H roll, and it is right beside the marked room so the detour is zero - decent bolt-on if you already have the marked key.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 308 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 308 on the third floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, third floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: The room is a pile of loose roubles and nothing else - the key's only real use now is as a Workbench level 2 craft input for a Can of thermite (Set of files "Master" + Metal cutting scissors + Dorm room 308 key + Gunpowder "Kite" + Metal spare parts, 2h 46m 40s).

cost_per_open.name: OLI outlet utility room key
cost_per_open.opens: The utility room of the OLI outlet store.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, at the OLI store's main entrance / checkout junction at the SOUTH end of the mall - the service door immediately behind and east of the OLI register bank, right beside the stairwell. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Twenty thousand roubles for a cupboard whose entire documented contents are the words "loose loot" - the clearest do-not-buy on Interchange.

cost_per_open.name: Hillside house key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the old village houses on the hillside
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Central, mid-map, up the hillside east of the main road (map pos ~[1400, 1934], ~353 units north-west of the Transit to Shoreline and ~190 units east / slightly south of the convenience store). It is the locked front door of the hillside village house. Off the main road, so it is the safest key run on Lighthouse.
cost_per_open.value_note: 510 rub per open for a multi-item military-electronics house away from the road funnel — the best risk-adjusted key on the map.

cost_per_open.name: SMW car key
cost_per_open.opens: The trunk of the blue car at the unlocked villa on Shoreline
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Not a door - the boot of the blue car parked at the UNLOCKED villa in the Villas / cottage area. Walk to the rear of the car and open the trunk.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheap at ~550 per open and a Yellow keycard lottery ticket, but only worth carrying if your route already goes through the villas.

cost_per_open.name: RB-MP21 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the Service and Repair Center workshop rooms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: 2nd floor of the western repair point building (black knight per the wiki), in the south-west repair complex.
cost_per_open.value_note: The best of the five MP workshop rooms - two intel spawns, a 4x4 weapon box, a 6-STEN and a weapon rack for 550 roubles a use.

cost_per_open.name: RB-MP11 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the Service and Repair Center workshop rooms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: 2nd floor of the Black Knight repair point building in the south-west repair complex.
cost_per_open.value_note: 550 a use for an intel folder spawn and a toolbox - pays for itself, just do not detour for it.

cost_per_open.name: MVD academy entrance hall guard room key
cost_per_open.opens: The guard room / reception off the entrance hall of the Ministry of the Interior (MVD) academy building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: MVD academy building (north-west side of the map, right next to the Transit to Ground Zero). Walk into the main entrance hall; the reception/guard room door is right there in the entrance hall.
cost_per_open.value_note: ~₽23k for 40 raids of a guaranteed ORSIS T-5000M plus multiple Bitcoin spawns - it pays for itself the first time it opens.

cost_per_open.name: HEP station storage room key
cost_per_open.opens: The USEC stash inside the hydroelectric power station - two separate doors on the second floor
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second floor of the hydroelectric power station building (away from the resort - the same station where the E222 and E328 keys spawn and where Voron's hideout is). There are two different doors that this key opens, and each one consumes a point of durability, so decide up front whether you need both.
cost_per_open.value_note: Four big weapon boxes, a toolbox and an Intelligence folder for ~580 roubles per door - trivially cheap and pays back immediately.

cost_per_open.name: Weather station safe key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - the safe at the weather station is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second floor of the weather station on the hill in the southeast, next to a desk. The safe is not locked. Be aware this is the Goons' (Knight, Big Pipe, Birdeye) spawn point.
cost_per_open.value_note: Wiki says no use, the safe is always unlocked. Worse than a waste of 23k - it can talk you into walking into the Goons for nothing.

cost_per_open.name: RB-AO key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the guard barracks' armories
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Inside the military / security barracks in the north-west of the map. The armoury door is directly visible from inside the RB-VO marked room, so the two are worth running together.
cost_per_open.value_note: Five weapon racks is the biggest AK dump on the map and the key spawns free on Shoreline - good for gun-runners and AK-74N quest turn-ins, mediocre for cash.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 118 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 118 on the first floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, first floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 583 RUB per open for a seven-way rifle roll plus a repair kit and two jackets - one SCAR-H or RD-704 pays for the key many times over.

cost_per_open.name: RB-TB key
cost_per_open.opens: The first barracks' underground shooting range
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Black Pawn / eastern barracks basement, near the parked helicopter. Enter via the north-east front door and go down; in the south section of the basement the grated door is on the east side of the hallway.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheap enough that three AK racks pay for it, and it is a two-second detour if you are already doing Reserve Expert in Black Pawn - but it is gun-runner loot, not roubles.

cost_per_open.name: OLI administration office key
cost_per_open.opens: The OLI administration (administrator's) office.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, inside the OLI hardware store at the SOUTH end of the mall. In the OLI front-office block on the store's west side there are two padlocked doors side by side with the restrooms directly across from them - the administration office is the NORTHERN / upper one, the logistics office is the southern one. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Paying 25,000 roubles to open a door onto one PC block, on a floor already littered with free PC blocks - do not buy it, just pick it up free in Shoreline E322 which no longer needs a key.

cost_per_open.name: Pinewood hotel room 206 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing. Pinewood hotel room 206 is permanently unlocked - this key has no usage in the game.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Room 206, second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building (northern entrance). You can simply walk in - the door is open every raid.
cost_per_open.value_note: A completely dead key that still sells for ~₽27k-36k. Do not buy it; if one drops, sell it to a player who has not read this.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 309 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 309 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor, room 309. Door is open.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key with an empty room behind it, still moving at 27k. Pure waste.

cost_per_open.name: Gas station safe key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - the safe in the Shoreline gas station is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The safe inside the gas station building on the coast road. It is not locked - just open it.
cost_per_open.value_note: The key's own wiki page says it outright: no use, the safe is always unlocked. Still selling at 27k to people reading old guides.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PSP1 key
cost_per_open.opens: The north-west caged-off storage area in the underground supply warehouse
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground storage bunkers, north-west corner cage. This cage has one lockable mesh door at its north end and one at its south end - RB-PSP1 opens both.
cost_per_open.value_note: Six supply crates plus a toolbox and repair kits - the hideout-feeder key, and cheap if you catch it near the low end.

cost_per_open.name: Supply department director's office key
cost_per_open.opens: The supply director's office on the second floor of the "Aspect" LLC building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Aspect LLC building (56 Primorsky Ave). Take the internal staircase to the second floor; the office door is off that landing.
cost_per_open.value_note: A drawer and a safe for ₽28k over 40 uses is not offensive, but Kaban's guards on the NSV and AGS overlook this building - the risk outweighs one safe.

cost_per_open.name: Conference room key
cost_per_open.opens: The conference room on the second floor of the guard building on the lighthouse peninsula
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Far SOUTH-WEST of the map on the lighthouse peninsula (map pos ~[668, 38], ~567 units south-east of the Zryachiy boss spawn, at the very southern tip). Enter the peninsula guard building, take the internal stairs to the second floor; the conference room door is off the landing. Same claymore/Zryachiy gate as the other two peninsula keys — you need an ENCODED Digital secure DSP radio transmitter.
cost_per_open.value_note: 700 rub per open is cheap, but a PC block and a 4x4 box is thin payoff for a trip past Zryachiy, and the safe in the room can never be opened — only worth it if you are already on the peninsula for the marked room.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 110 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 110 (Kozlov's room) on the first floor of the two-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-storey dorms, first floor, on the opposite side of the fenced-off section from room 105 and across the hallway from 114. The Accidental Witness note is stuck on the wall below the room number.
cost_per_open.value_note: Do not buy this one at all if you can help it - a key is guaranteed in the warehouse #17 changing-room locker every single raid, and it is a story-chapter requirement plus a safe and an Intelligence folder roll.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 303 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 303 on the third floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, third floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 725 RUB per open with a coin-flip on a G28 or SCAR-H, and it is mandatory for Golden Swag - older guides that call 303 "not worth taking" predate the rare weapon spawn being confirmed.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 316 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 316
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, door marked 316. Central Administration or east wing stairwell to 3F, then along the east corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 730 roubles per open for a Red keycard chance, two weapon boxes, a medbag and an SV-98 - one of the cheapest keys on the map that actually pays.

cost_per_open.name: RB-RS key
cost_per_open.opens: The Radar Station server room
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Radar Station (Queen), middle floor - the last door on the left at the end of the hallway.
cost_per_open.value_note: The toolbox count rolls between zero and five, so it is a coin-flip room - worth it at 30k, skip it at 60k.

cost_per_open.name: Convenience store storage room key
cost_per_open.opens: The storage room inside the roadside convenience store (blue door)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Central, mid-map, right on the main road (map pos ~[1214, 2039], ~338 units south of the WTP's southern NSV emplacement). Go into the convenience store off the main road; the storage room is the BLUE DOOR inside. It sits in the map's main road death funnel, so it is more dangerous than the loot deserves.
cost_per_open.value_note: 286 rub per open is basically free, but a medcase and an MP-133 on the most-shot road on the map is a marginal trade — only take it if you are looting the store anyway.

cost_per_open.name: Merin car trunk key
cost_per_open.opens: The trunk of the Merin sports coupe
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Central-west of the map, mid-map, on a small parking lot west of the main road (map pos ~[905, 1704], ~373 units west of the chalet-area Goons spawn, ~583 units north-west of the Mountain Pass extract). A PMC spawn is ~97 units away, so it is often contested in the first minute. Unlock the trunk, not the doors.
cost_per_open.value_note: 793 rub per open for a Bitcoin chance plus Virtex plus COFDM in a 3-second trunk pop — easy yes, just expect company at the nearby PMC spawn.

cost_per_open.name: PE teacher's office key
cost_per_open.opens: The physical education teacher's office in the sports hall on the first floor of School No. 30
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: School No. 30. Enter through the SOUTH entrance, turn immediately left into the sports hall - the office door is on your left as you enter the hall.
cost_per_open.value_note: One Bitcoin spawn behind a door 20 seconds from the south entrance, for ₽32k over 40 uses. Cheap and quick, but it is the only thing in the room.

cost_per_open.name: Gas station office key
cost_per_open.opens: The director's office inside the new gas station
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: New gas station on the east side of the map - go inside, down the hallway, last room on the right at the end.
cost_per_open.value_note: 825 RUB per open for a safe, a pistol, a 4x4 weapon box roll and the storage room key sitting under the desk - it opens the door to a second locked room, which is what makes it worth it.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PSV1 key
cost_per_open.opens: The south-east caged-off storage area in the underground supply warehouse
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground storage bunkers (the big supply warehouse level). Head to the south-east corner cage; the iron mesh door is on that cage.
cost_per_open.value_note: Three medical supply crates for ~830 roubles a use, and the key spawns free on the same map - the best of the four underground cages.

cost_per_open.name: Zmeisky 5 apartment 20 key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 20 on the fifth floor of the Zmeisky 5 building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Zmeisky 5. Take the staircase all the way to the FIFTH floor; apartment 20's door is on that landing.
cost_per_open.value_note: The COFDM spawn is real value for ₽33k, but a five-storey climb in a dead corner of the map for one transmitter is a poor use of raid time.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing office room 108 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 108 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, ground floor, room 108, in the 1xx east corridor next to office 107. The door is open; walk in.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key. The wiki states plainly that room 108 is always unlocked and there is no documented loot inside - do not buy at 34k or any price.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 213 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 213 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, room 213. Door is open, and the balcony connects to 209 which is also open.
cost_per_open.value_note: Dead key still trading at 34k. The 5x5 weapon box behind it is genuinely worth looting - you just do not pay for the privilege any more.

cost_per_open.name: RB-AM key
cost_per_open.opens: The Educational Building (School / Black Bishop) workshop
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: School / Educational Building marked with a black bishop, west side, ground floor - the workshop door is at the bottom of the west staircase.
cost_per_open.value_note: Three toolboxes and an Old firesteel feed the hideout nicely, and the key is sitting on a desk on the D-2 route you already run.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia apartment 8 room key
cost_per_open.opens: The bedroom door in apartment 8 on the third floor of the Concordia building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia. HOUSE NO. 1 staircase to the third floor, into apartment 8, bedroom door off its hallway. You can also reach it via the breakthrough hole from apartment 34 (house no. 2 staircase), skipping apartment 8's front door.
cost_per_open.value_note: Loose valuables and nothing else. Skip unless you are already standing in apartment 8 for the cinema room.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort universal utility room key
cost_per_open.opens: Two utility rooms in the Health Resort west wing
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, two doors: the utility room next to room 227 on the SECOND floor, and the utility room next to room 327 on the THIRD floor. Both sit right alongside the numbered rooms in the west corridors. Worth knowing that these utility rooms contain key racks that are documented spawn points for the E306, E328, W112, W216, W219 and W220 keys.
cost_per_open.value_note: No high-value spawns, but ~900 per open for two rooms of tools and building materials feeds the hideout, and the key racks inside hand you other keys for free.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 313 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 313, plus room 314 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, door marked 313. Central Administration or east wing stairwell up to 3F, then along the east corridor. Balcony inside connects to 314.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 920 per open for a LEDX, a 6x3 box and a medbag, and it is both cheaper and better-stocked than the E314 key for the same pair.

cost_per_open.name: RB-MP12 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the Service and Repair Center workshop rooms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: 1st floor of the Black Knight repair point building in the south-west repair complex.
cost_per_open.value_note: Guaranteed intel folder plus a 6-STEN for ~920 a use; the key is free off the Woods sawmill locker if you run Woods at all.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia security room key
cost_per_open.opens: The security room in the basement parking garage of the Concordia apartment complex
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia complex. Take the house no. 1 staircase down to the basement parking garage; the security room door sits in the wall right beside the bottom of that staircase.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two PC blocks and a safe for ~₽38k over 40 uses, and it clears a mandatory Mechanic quest. Near-zero downside.

cost_per_open.name: Archive room key
cost_per_open.opens: The archive room on the second floor of the Zmeisky 3a building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Zmeisky 3a. The building entrance is on the BACK side. Go in, down the hallway to the staircase, up to the second floor, along the second-floor hallway - the archive door is at the end.
cost_per_open.value_note: A safe and two drawers for ~₽40k over 40 uses is fair, but the room is a long detour for three containers. Only worth it if your route already passes Zmeisky.

cost_per_open.name: Gas station storage room key
cost_per_open.opens: The storage closet inside the new gas station
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: New gas station - inside, down the hallway, first room on the right (the office is the last room on the right at the far end).
cost_per_open.value_note: 975 RUB per open for two med containers - worth it while meds are expensive, and you get one free every time you open the gas station office.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 306 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 306, plus room 308 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor. Up the central Administration stairwell or the east wing stairwell to 3F, then along the east corridor to the door marked 306. The balcony inside links straight into 308, so this one key clears both rooms.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 965 roubles per open for a LEDX, a DVL-10 and four PC blocks - the best rouble-per-loot key on Shoreline and it spawns free in six places.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 314 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 314, plus room 313 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, door marked 314. Central Administration or east wing stairwell to 3F, along the east corridor. Balcony inside links to 313.
cost_per_open.value_note: Redundant - the E313 key is cheaper and puts you straight in the room with the LEDX; only buy this if 313 is unavailable.

cost_per_open.name: Rogue USEC stash key
cost_per_open.opens: A Rogue cabin (stash) in the west of the water treatment plant
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Western edge of the water treatment plant (map pos ~[997, 2571], ~217 units north of the WTP southern AGS-30 emplacement, ~314 units north-east of the Scav Hideout at the Grotto scav extract). It is the standalone cabin right next to the police truck — the two locks are only ~75 units apart, so always carry both keys together.
cost_per_open.value_note: 575-978 rub per open for the densest weapon-box cluster on Lighthouse (5x5 plus 4x4 plus 5x2) plus two BattlePass documents — strong if you can survive the Rogue guns overhead.

cost_per_open.name: RB-RLSA key
cost_per_open.opens: The Radar Station document archives
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: White Queen building (the dome / radar station), east end of the building, 2nd floor.
cost_per_open.value_note: An intel folder plus a COFDM spawn for 1,000 a use is fine, and the trader buyback is almost the flea price so your downside is tiny.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing office room 107 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing office room 107 (a two-room office)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, GROUND floor. Walk the 1xx east corridor to the door marked 107 - no stairs, no third-floor commitment. It is a two-room office once you are through.
cost_per_open.value_note: A LEDX and a GPU for ~1,020 per open behind a ground-floor door - the safest high-value key on the map for a low-kit player.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 206 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 206, plus room 205 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, door marked 206. Up to 2F by the central Administration or east wing stairwell and along the east corridor. Balcony inside links to 205.
cost_per_open.value_note: Four weapon boxes, two rifles and a Red keycard spawn for ~1,030 per open, and it is the cheap side of the 205/206 pair - never buy the E205 key.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing office room 112 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing office room 112
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, GROUND floor - room 112, in the 1xx west corridor. No stairs required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Buy it for Vitamins, not for the loot - two keycard spawn chances and two sport bags is thin, but the quest and the Crash Axe barter make it necessary.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PSV2 key
cost_per_open.opens: The north-east caged-off storage area in the underground supply warehouse
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground storage bunkers, north-east corner cage. One lockable mesh door at the north end and one at the south end of the cage, both RB-PSV2.
cost_per_open.value_note: Three medical crates and a technical crate for ~1,000 a use; drops from Shturman's stash so farm it on-cycle rather than paying flea.

cost_per_open.name: RB-GN key
cost_per_open.opens: The Airspace Control Center bunker generator room
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Basement / bunker level of the Airspace Control Center (King). Down the stairs, the generator room is the metal door on the right.
cost_per_open.value_note: 41k for two toolboxes and three maybes, with a 2,688 trader buyback - the worst price-to-contents ratio of any working Reserve key.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia apartment 8 home cinema key
cost_per_open.opens: The home cinema room in apartment 8 on the third floor of the Concordia building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia. Either take the HOUSE NO. 1 staircase up to the third floor, into apartment 8, and the cinema door is off its hallway - OR take the house no. 2 staircase to apartment 34 and use the breakthrough hole in apartment 34's hallway to get into apartment 8 without a key.
cost_per_open.value_note: A reliable COFDM spawn for ₽41k over 40 uses is genuinely good, and the apartment-34 breakthrough means you do not need the apartment-8 door key to reach it.

cost_per_open.name: RB-KORL key
cost_per_open.opens: The Radar Station commander's office
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Radar Station, 2nd floor. Come up the stairs into the hallway - it is the first door on the left.
cost_per_open.value_note: Up to three Intelligence folder spawns in one small room, and the key itself spawns on the King desk you walk past anyway - free money if you farm it.

cost_per_open.name: Rus Post car key
cost_per_open.opens: The driver's door and trunk of the blue Rus Post service van parked in front of the post office
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The blue Rus Post van parked directly in front of the post office building.
cost_per_open.value_note: The van is empty outside Blue Fire, and the key lies on the ground next to its own back wheel every single raid. Buying this is pure waste.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 216 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 216
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 216. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor. No balcony partner - this is a single room.
cost_per_open.value_note: Best gun-and-ammo key on the map - LEDX, an M4A1, three weapon boxes, two grenade boxes and free loaded GEN M3 mags for ~1,080 per open.

cost_per_open.name: USEC stash key
cost_per_open.opens: A storage room on the first floor of warehouse #6. It used to open TWO storage rooms there; since 1.0 the first room (the one by the stairs) can be breached instead, so the key now only matters for the second room.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Warehouse #6, over by the fuel silos near the ZB-1011 bunker extract - ground floor, the storage room off the main floor (the warehouse with the green screen room).
cost_per_open.value_note: 1,125 RUB per open and two 4x4 weapon boxes plus a NATO rifle roll is genuinely good - but you are now paying for one room instead of two, and Therapist buys the key back at 42,947 RUB, which tells you the market has repriced it.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing office room 104 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing office room 104
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, GROUND floor - room 104 in the 1xx west corridor. Ground level, quick access.
cost_per_open.value_note: One LEDX and a Blue keycard chance for ~1,170 per open - fine on a ground-floor route, but E107 gives you a LEDX and a GPU for less.

cost_per_open.name: Operating room key
cost_per_open.opens: The operating room / hidden recording studio (broadcasting and surgical equipment) on the ground floor of office building #1 at the water treatment plant
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Water treatment plant, north of the map (map pos ~[1024, 2745], roughly 390 units north of the WTP's southern AGS-30 emplacement and south-west of the Goons' WTP spawn). Enter office building #1 — the westernmost of the three big WTP office blocks — and go to the ground floor. The room is in the NORTHEAST corner of the building. Rogue and Scav spawns sit ~20 units from the door, so clear the ground floor before you touch it.
cost_per_open.value_note: 1,213 rub per open for a Bitcoin spawn plus Phased array element plus COFDM, and it clears a Kappa quest — the best rouble-per-use key on the map.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 222 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 222, plus rooms 218 and 221 via the shared balconies
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor. Up to 2F via the central Administration stairwell or the west wing stairwell, then along the west corridor to the door marked 222. From inside, the balconies connect to both 221 and 218, so this single door gets you a three-room sweep.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 1,230 roubles per open for three rooms and a Red keycard spawn - the exact same access the W221 key charges 183k for. Buy this one.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 306 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 306 on the third floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, third floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 1,250 RUB per open for a three-way rare rifle roll plus cash - profitable over 40 uses, but 50k up front is steep and it has no free spawn point on the map.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia apartment 34 room key
cost_per_open.opens: The bedroom door in apartment 34 on the third floor of the Concordia building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia. Take the HOUSE NO. 2 staircase to the third floor, along the hallway to apartment 34's door, then the bedroom door is off apartment 34's internal corridor. Two bedrooms are behind it.
cost_per_open.value_note: Worth it at ₽50k for the COFDM, and apartment 34 is the free back door into apartment 8's cinema and bedroom via the wall breakthrough. Skip it above ₽90k.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 310 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 310
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, door marked 310. Central Administration or east wing stairwell to 3F, along the east corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two sport bags for 51k. No keycard, no balcony, no quest - the weakest paid room on the third floor.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 216 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 216 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, room 216 (the wiki's Lock Location line says "West Wing" here, which is a typo - there is a separate W216 key with its own room and loot). Either way, the door is open.
cost_per_open.value_note: The single worst purchase on the map: ~51k for an unlocked door with no documented loot behind it. Do not confuse it with the West 216 key, which is excellent.

cost_per_open.name: X-ray room key
cost_per_open.opens: The x-ray control room on the second floor of Children's Polyclinic No. 69
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Children's polyclinic no. 69. Go upstairs and open the door on the LEFT, walk down the corridor and through the second door - that puts you in the (unlocked) x-ray room, and the locked control room is off it.
cost_per_open.value_note: Buy it only for the Therapist quest - one drawer and some loose meds is not worth ₽51k on its own, and the key has six free spawn spots across the vet clinic and polyclinic.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort management office safe key
cost_per_open.opens: A safe in one of the offices in the resort Administration building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The Administration (central) building at the health resort - the safe sits in one of the offices there. Item description calls it the sanatorium warehouse OFFICE safe, distinct from the warehouse safe on 2F north.
cost_per_open.value_note: One safe, but 40 uses drops it to ~1,300 per open, which a resort safe clears on average - worth it only if you run admin every raid.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort management warehouse safe key
cost_per_open.opens: A locked safe in the resort Administration building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second floor of the NORTH wing (the central Administration block) of the health resort. Different safe from the management office safe - this is the sanatorium warehouse safe.
cost_per_open.value_note: Same maths as the office safe key - about 1,300 a pop for one safe, acceptable on a repeated admin route, pointless as a one-off.

cost_per_open.name: Zmeisky 3 apartment key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 7 on the first floor of the Zmeisky 3 building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Zmeisky 3. Entrance is on the BACKYARD side; apartment 7's door is on the ground floor, a different door from apartment 8 upstairs.
cost_per_open.value_note: Buy one for the Accidental Witness chapter and then forget it - loose household loot does not repay ₽26k+ at 20 uses.

cost_per_open.name: Primorsky 48 apartment key
cost_per_open.opens: The living room door in apartment 6 on the second floor of the Primorsky 48 building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Primorsky 48. The building entrance is on the BACKYARD side. Take the staircase to the second floor, in through apartment 6's door, then the living room door is off apartment 6's hallway.
cost_per_open.value_note: Loose loot behind two doors on the wrong side of the building. No quest, no containers - not worth ₽54k+.

cost_per_open.name: RB-ST key
cost_per_open.opens: The locked storeroom inside the repair warehouse / garage of the Repair Point Buildings
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: South-west of the map at the repair centre. Go to the bigger of the two garage buildings at the white knight repair point; the locked door is inside the garage bay (also visible/approachable from outside the garages). This is the room that holds the third BMP-2.
cost_per_open.value_note: Three weapon boxes, two grenade boxes and a TP-200 for ~1,600 roubles a use, and three separate quests force you to buy it anyway - the one auto-buy on Reserve.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 303 key
cost_per_open.opens: Nothing - room 303 is permanently unlocked
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor, room 303. Door is open - and there is still a reason to go, because the room holds a TerraGroup Labs Yellow keycard spawn location.
cost_per_open.value_note: Classic trap: people pay ~56k because of the Yellow keycard spawn, but the door has been a walk-in since 1.x. Check the room, skip the key.

cost_per_open.name: Rogue USEC barrack key
cost_per_open.opens: A Rogue makeshift barrack room on the first floor of office building #3 at the water treatment plant
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Water treatment plant, north of the map (map pos ~[1455, 2785], ~238 units south-east of the WTP Goons spawn and ~283 units south of the Industrial Zone Gates scav extract). Office building #3 is the eastern WTP office block. On the first floor, go to the SOUTHWEST corner — that is the barrack door.
cost_per_open.value_note: 750-1,438 rub per open for a Bitcoin chair plus two weapon boxes is fine value — but do NOT buy it thinking Getting Acquainted needs it, because it does not.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 203 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 203, plus room 205 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 203. Up either the central Administration stairwell or the west wing stairwell to 2F and along the west corridor. The balcony inside opens into 205.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two LEDX, a GPU and a Red keycard spawn for about 1,470 roubles per open, and cheaper than the W205 key that opens the identical pair.

cost_per_open.name: RB-OB key
cost_per_open.opens: The first barracks' duty officer's room
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Black Pawn / eastern barracks, northern end of the eastern building, 3rd floor. Use the northern staircase; the door faces the Black Bishop (School) side.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheapest of the four Reserve Expert keys and the key has three fixed spawns in the King building - grab it there rather than paying 59k.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 321 safe key
cost_per_open.opens: A safe inside Health Resort west wing room 321
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor, room 321 - the safe is inside that room, so you need to get into 321 first. Up to 3F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 1,530 per open for one safe on a floor you are probably already looting - fine, but the free spawn sits in a Goons-infested tower.

cost_per_open.name: OLI logistics department office key
cost_per_open.opens: The OLI logistics department office.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, inside the OLI hardware store at the SOUTH end of the mall. Go into the OLI front-office block on the store's west side; there are two padlocked doors side by side with the restrooms between them - the logistics department office is the SOUTHERN / lower one (the administration office is the northern one). The OLI cargo route documents are on the left-hand shelf as you walk in. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Buy exactly one, for A Big Loss - the moment the quest is done the room is a single PC block and the key is dead money at 61,000 roubles; take the free Customs blue-car-trunk spawn if you can.

cost_per_open.name: Beluga restaurant director key
cost_per_open.opens: The director's office on the third floor of the Beluga restaurant
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Beluga restaurant (stylobate building). Take the stairs to the third floor - the office is reachable either from the third-floor main room or from the third-floor kitchen. The Stylobate Building Elevator PMC extract is behind the bar on this same third floor.
cost_per_open.value_note: Fine value at ₽65k over 40 uses thanks to the Bitcoin spawn, and the room sits on top of an extract. Be aware the safe inside is permanently unopenable - do not go hunting for a key that does not exist.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 205 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 205, plus room 206 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, door marked 205. Up to 2F by the central Administration or east wing stairwell. Balcony inside links to 206.
cost_per_open.value_note: The expensive half of the 205/206 pair - the E206 key opens both for ~25k less and starts you in the better room.

cost_per_open.name: Cargo container mesh door key
cost_per_open.opens: The grate door inside a shipping container between the LexOs car dealership and the car workshop
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The container yard between the LexOs car dealership and the car repair workshop. Walk into the shipping container; the mesh/grate door partitions off the closed rear section.
cost_per_open.value_note: Three loot containers including a 5x5 weapon box for under ₽45k across 20 raids - roughly ₽2k per open. Best crate density per rouble on Streets.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 218 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 218 on the second floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, second floor corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 1,750 RUB per open for one loose gun and some mods, at a 70k entry price, when the guard desk cabinet rolls it for free - the worst purchase on Customs relative to price.

cost_per_open.name: RB-KPRL key
cost_per_open.opens: The Radar Station guardhouse (both of its doors take the same key)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The southern-most small building at the foot of the radio/radar tower, i.e. the guard building just outside the radar station on the western path. There are two lockable doors on the shack and RB-KPRL opens both.
cost_per_open.value_note: Five container spawns plus two Intelligence folders inside one tiny shack - the best container density per rouble on the map, if you accept the exposed walk out to the radar path.

cost_per_open.name: Financial institution office key
cost_per_open.opens: An office on the second floor of the financial institution building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Financial institution building. Take the internal staircase to the second floor; the locked office is off the second-floor landing.
cost_per_open.value_note: Five PC blocks in one room is the densest GPU/electronics-farm door on Streets. Worth it at the ₽71k 7-day average, marginal if you pay the ₽136k spike.

cost_per_open.name: Cottage back door key
cost_per_open.opens: The back door of the eastern (locked) cottage in the Villas area on Shoreline
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The Villas / cottage cluster, away from the resort. Go to the eastern of the two cottages - the locked one - and around to the BACK door; the front stays locked. Note the yellow keycard and both safes are inside, and the second-floor safe needs the separate Cottage safe key.
cost_per_open.value_note: Quest-required and well stocked, but with four documented free spawns in the villas and village you should find it rather than pay 72k.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 308 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 308, plus room 306 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, door marked 308. Central Administration or east wing stairwell to 3F. Balcony inside links to 306.
cost_per_open.value_note: Nearly double the E306 key's price for the exact same two rooms, and it drops you in the empty one. Economically dead - never buy it.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia apartment 63 room key
cost_per_open.opens: The living room door in apartment 63 on the second floor of the Concordia building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia, HOUSE NO. 3 staircase to the second floor. Follow the hallway to apartment 63; the living room door is off it.
cost_per_open.value_note: Loose loot only, and the good COFDM spawns in apartment 63 are on the unlocked side of this door. ₽72k+ is hard to justify.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 114 key
cost_per_open.opens: Dorm room 114 on the first floor of the two-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-storey dorms, first floor, directly across the hallway from room 110.
cost_per_open.value_note: 1,806 RUB per open for a medcase, a safe and a PC block - the medcase alone usually covers it, and it is the mandatory Pharmacist room.

cost_per_open.name: RB-KSM key
cost_per_open.opens: The Military unit HQ doctor's office
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: White Bishop (HQ / hospital) building, 2nd floor - the other locked medical door alongside RB-SMP.
cost_per_open.value_note: A sports bag and some meds for 73k is a bad loot trade; buy it once for Disease History and then never again.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 205 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 205, plus room 203 via the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 205. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell. Balcony inside links to 203.
cost_per_open.value_note: Great rooms, wrong key - the W203 key opens the identical pair for about 16k less. Buy 203.

cost_per_open.name: Pinewood hotel room 215 key
cost_per_open.opens: Room 215 on the second floor of the NORTHERN Pinewood hotel building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Pinewood hotel, northern building. Use the northern entrance and go to the second floor; room 215 is along that corridor. (The Pinewood Basement co-op extract is in the north-eastern staircase of the same hotel.)
cost_per_open.value_note: A Golden 1GPhone plus a COFDM transmitter behind one door over 40 uses genuinely pays back, and it clears a Mechanic quest. Solid B, borderline A if you find it under ₽75k.

cost_per_open.name: EMERCOM medical unit key
cost_per_open.opens: The EMERCOM medical care unit on the first floor of the ULTRA mall. The unit has THREE separate lockable doors and opening each one spends a use.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, in the central mall concourse on the north side of the middle of the mall - the free-standing white EMERCOM unit between the IDEA (north) end and the Kiba/Goshan crossroads. Walk the main first-floor concourse from IDEA southward and it is the standalone medical block on your right/east. Three doors on different faces of the same unit; you only need one, so do not waste durability opening all three. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: LEDX plus a defibrillator plus two medbags, no power switch needed, 40 uses, and barterable if the flea spikes - at 75-100k this is the most consistently profitable key on the map.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 218 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 218, plus rooms 221 and 222 via the shared balconies
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 218. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell, then along the west corridor. Balconies inside run to both 221 and 222.
cost_per_open.value_note: Same three-room cluster as W222 but ~27k more expensive; a fine key, just the second-cheapest door into it.

cost_per_open.name: Financial institution small office key
cost_per_open.opens: A small office on the first floor of the financial institution building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Financial institution building, ground floor. Follow the ground-floor hallway; the small office door is off that corridor (separate door from the second-floor office).
cost_per_open.value_note: Seven containers including a safe for ~₽80k over 40 uses. Pairs with the second-floor office key for a single-building run.

cost_per_open.name: Rogue USEC workshop key
cost_per_open.opens: A Rogue workshop bunkhouse cabin in the east of the water treatment plant
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Eastern edge of the water treatment plant (map pos ~[1440, 2460], ~348 units east of the WTP's southern NSV emplacement and ~414 units west of the Passage by the Lake extract). It is the standalone cabin on the WTP's east side; the locked door is the cabin's front door.
cost_per_open.value_note: 48k-78k for two toolboxes and a jacket is the worst price-to-loot ratio of any live Lighthouse key — the only reason to touch it is the 6-STEN battery and a BattlePass document, and neither is worth the walk.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PSP2 key
cost_per_open.opens: The south-west caged-off storage area in the underground supply warehouse
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground storage bunkers, south-west corner cage - the iron mesh door on that cage.
cost_per_open.value_note: Fine but the weakest of the four cages - only one medical crate - and the Jaeger LL4 barter costs far more than the flea price, so ignore the barter.

cost_per_open.name: RB-SMP key
cost_per_open.opens: The Military unit HQ medical storage room
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: White Bishop (HQ / hospital) building, 2nd floor. It is one of the two locked medical doors up there - the other is RB-KSM.
cost_per_open.value_note: Overpriced for loose meds, but Disease History makes it compulsory - farm it off Shturman on-cycle instead of paying 100k.

cost_per_open.name: Car dealership director's office room key
cost_per_open.opens: The director's office inside the closed second-floor section of the LexOs car dealership
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: LexOs car dealership, second floor. You must first open the closed section with the Car dealership closed section key; the director's office door is inside that section.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheap, but useless on its own - it lives behind a ₽520,000 one-use door. Peacekeeper hands you one free with the quest, so there is almost never a reason to buy it.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort office key with a blue tape
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 110 (Sanitar's office)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, GROUND floor - room 110. Enter the east wing at ground level (the East Wing Gym Entrance scav extract side, or in from the central Administration block) and follow the 1xx corridor to the door marked 110. No stairs needed, which makes this the fastest high-value stop in the resort.
cost_per_open.value_note: Best medical room on the map and it is free if you kill Sanitar on an on-cycle raid; at ~2,250 roubles per open it still pays even if you buy it.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 220 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 220
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 220. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.
cost_per_open.value_note: Costs about the same as W219 but has no keycard spawn, no armour and no rifle - if you are buying for I Need More Power, buy 219 instead. It does have six free spawn spots though.

cost_per_open.name: Store manager's key
cost_per_open.opens: The manager's office on the second floor of the "Sparja" store
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Sparja supermarket. Go in through the EASTERN door into the staff/personnel tract, take the staircase in that tract up to the second floor; the office door is up there.
cost_per_open.value_note: Safe plus PC block plus two drawers is solid, but ₽90k is steep for a shop office with no quest attached. Buy it after the S-tier list, not before.

cost_per_open.name: Kiba Arms inner grate door key
cost_per_open.opens: The inner grate door of the KIBA Arms International store - the one that actually lets you at the guns.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, centre of the mall: a couple of metres inside the KIBA Arms outer door, on the west side of the central crossroads opposite Goshan. You cannot reach it without first opening the outer door with the Kiba Arms outer door key (which needs power and trips the alarm). The grate door itself does not need power.
cost_per_open.value_note: The cheaper half of the Kiba pair and the half that holds all the loot; strong value at 90k, but completely dead weight unless you also own the outer key.

cost_per_open.name: USEC cottage second safe key
cost_per_open.opens: The wall safe in the south-western second-floor bedroom of the blue chalet (USEC cottages). Also opens four erroneously locked, permanently EMPTY safes on Streets of Tarkov
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East side of the map, mid-map, chalet hill (safe at map pos ~[1767, 1461], ~267 units south of the Path to Shoreline extract, ~73 units south of the first safe). Second floor of the blue chalet, SOUTH-WESTERN bedroom. Pair it with the first safe key — same building, same trip.
cost_per_open.value_note: Same loot pool as the first safe for roughly half the price — 1,500-2,265 rub per open, an obvious buy. Ignore the four Streets safes it also opens; they are bugged and always empty.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia apartment 64 office room key
cost_per_open.opens: The office room inside apartment 64 on the second floor of the Concordia building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia, HOUSE NO. 3 staircase to the second floor. You must first open apartment 64's front door with the Concordia apartment 64 key; the office door is inside the apartment.
cost_per_open.value_note: The UHF RFID Reader spawn matters if you are crafting the A.P. keycard for The Unheard. Otherwise it is gated behind a ₽650,000+ door, which kills the maths.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 219 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 219
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 219. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.
cost_per_open.value_note: Pricey for one room, but if you need I Need More Power this is the better of the two options - W220 costs about the same and has worse loot.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 301 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 301, plus room 304 via the shared sea-facing balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor. Take the central Administration glass stairwell or the west wing's own stairwell up to 3F and walk the west corridor until you see 301 painted above the door. Once inside, go out onto the balcony and cut into 304 - there is no W304 key, so this door is the only way into the best room on the floor.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 2,450 roubles per open for multiple LEDX, three GPU spawns, two PC blocks and a 5x5 weapon box - it repays itself on the first extract and 39 more times after.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup security armory key
cost_per_open.opens: The security armory on the first floor of the TerraGroup security post building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: TerraGroup security post building. Enter the main door, follow the interior corridor past the reception; the armory is the heavy door at the end of that route on the ground floor.
cost_per_open.value_note: Seven containers plus two weapon racks over 40 uses - about ₽3k per raid. The best gun-loot room on Streets and it pays back in one visit.

cost_per_open.name: Cult victim's apartment key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 5 on the third floor of the old apartment building behind the Klimov shopping mall
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The old apartment building directly behind (east of) the Klimov shopping mall. Climb to the third floor; apartment 5's door is on that landing.
cost_per_open.value_note: Provisions. That is the entire loot list. Purely a story-chapter key - and it spawns free and guaranteed on Lighthouse, so buying it at ₽50k is a waste.

cost_per_open.name: OLI cash register key
cost_per_open.opens: The locked Cash register TAR2-2 units at the OLI store front (18 of them).
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, OLI hardware store at the SOUTH end of the mall. The locked register bank sits at the OLI store's main entrance / checkout junction where the central concourse meets OLI, right next to the stairwell. The OLI outlet utility room service door is a few metres behind the same register bank. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Fewest registers of the three (18) at ~100,000 roubles, so the worst register key on pure economics - buy one for Supervisor, then grab the free copy off the table in OLI's back office from then on.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 328 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 328, plus a connected utility room via the balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, third floor, door marked 328 - the high end of the 3F east corridor. Up via the central Administration or east wing stairwell. The balcony inside leads into a utility room.
cost_per_open.value_note: Quest-required and LEDX+GPU behind it, but at ~2,620 per open just barter it from Mechanic LL2 or grab one of its six free spawns instead of paying flea.

cost_per_open.name: Iron gate key
