cost_per_open.opens: The grate doors on prison cells no. 1, 2 and 4 on the third floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building (the improvised jail)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Chekannaya 15. Get inside through the marked hole in the exterior wall, work your way to the WESTERN staircase, climb to the third floor - the barred cells line that third-floor hallway. Cells 1, 2 and 4 all use this one key.
cost_per_open.value_note: One key, three cells, 40 uses, and it is needed for two Skier quests. Buy it once and stop thinking about it.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup meeting room key
cost_per_open.opens: The meeting room on the first floor of the TerraGroup security post building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: TerraGroup security post building. As you walk in the entrance, the meeting room door is immediately on your left.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two Intelligence folder spawns two steps inside the door. If you still need Intelligence Center 2 (3 folders) this is the fastest farm on the map; once your hideout is done its value drops hard.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 226 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 226, plus room 222 and the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, door marked 226 - near the 227 end of the 2F east corridor. Reach 2F by the central Administration stairwell or the east wing stairwell. Once in, the shared balcony (which itself holds a weapon locker) runs across into 222.
cost_per_open.value_note: Multiple LEDX plus a Physical Bitcoin, RSASS and SV-98 next door for ~2,780 per open, and slightly cheaper than the E222 key for the same pair.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup corporate apartment key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex (A.P.'s corporate flat)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Cardinal apartment complex, second floor. Apartment 1's front door is on that landing - a different door from apartment 2 (Cardinal apartment key).
cost_per_open.value_note: Thin loot on its own - buy it only because The Unheard needs it, and prefer the free guaranteed spawn in Shoreline east wing 305.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort east wing room 222 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort east wing room 222, plus room 226 and the shared balcony
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East wing, second floor, door marked 222. Up the central Administration or east wing stairwell to 2F and along the east corridor. Balcony inside links to 226; the balcony itself has a weapon locker.
cost_per_open.value_note: Genuinely great loot at ~2,980 per open, but the E226 key opens the identical pair for less - buy that instead unless this one is cheaper on the day.

cost_per_open.name: Object #21WS keycard
cost_per_open.opens: The red TerraGroup shipping container in the container lot outside the mall.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Outside the mall, to the SOUTH-WEST, in the shipping-container lot between the mall and the highway. Look for the single RED TerraGroup container stacked on top of other containers - the card panel is on its door, and you have to get up onto the stack to reach it. THE POWER MUST BE ON. This is well away from the mall fighting, so it is a safe first or last stop depending on your spawn.
cost_per_open.value_note: Thirty thousand roubles for three weapon boxes, an MPX and a class-5-tier Trooper TFO, in the quietest corner of the map - the best roubles-in / roubles-out ratio on Interchange and a two-quest gate on top.

cost_per_open.name: RB-ORB2 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the southern barracks armories
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: White Pawn / southern barracks, east end of the southern building, 2nd floor - the locked grate door on the side facing Black Pawn.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two weapon boxes is the best loot of the four Reserve Expert rooms, but 121k is silly when this key has six fixed spawns plus Shturman's stash - farm it.

cost_per_open.name: ULTRA medical storage key
cost_per_open.opens: The storage room inside the pharmacy (AПTEKA) unit in the mall.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second floor, south-west corner block of the mall - the pharmacy unit at the OLI (south) end of the second-floor plan, on the west side. The padlocked door is on the unit's inner wall behind the shop floor. THE POWER MUST BE ON or the door will not open, so flip the switch in the power station in the north-east of the map first.
cost_per_open.value_note: About 3,300 roubles per entry across 40 uses for a room with four LEDX spawn points - one LEDX repays the entire key several times, making this the highest expected value per rouble on the map after the keycards.

cost_per_open.name: IDEA cash register key
cost_per_open.opens: The locked Cash register TAR2-2 units at the IDEA store front (20 of them), AND the 2 TAR2-2 registers inside the NecrusPharm pharmacy.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, IDEA store at the NORTH end of the mall. The locked register row runs along the IDEA store's west edge, facing the main first-floor corridor - you pass it on the way in from the north side of the mall. The extra 2 registers are inside NecrusPharm, which you can only reach with the NecrusPharm pharmacy key. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: 22 registers for ~133,000 roubles is thin on its own; buy it because Supervisor is Kappa-required, and check the white bus outside IDEA every raid so you never need a second one.

cost_per_open.name: Military checkpoint key
cost_per_open.opens: The military base checkpoint tower / gatehouse
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: North-east of the map at the military base checkpoint, by the Military Base CP and Scav Checkpoint extracts - the door is on the bottom floor of the eastern guard tower.
cost_per_open.value_note: 3,500 RUB per open for grenade and ammo boxes plus a weapon locker, which is fine - but with four free spawn points on the map there is no reason to spend 140k. Note the door used to be bugged shut; that wiki bug note was removed in April 2026 and it works now.

cost_per_open.name: NecrusPharm pharmacy key
cost_per_open.opens: The "NecrusPharm" pharmacy store (two rooms - a front room and a back room).
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: On the current 2026 map the padlocked NecrusPharm door is on the PARKING / garage level, on the WEST side of the parking garage in its north-west portion - a small pharmacy unit set into the west wall next to a stairwell and a rounded cafe/seating area, near the IDEA garage section. Note the wiki's own text still describes it vaguely as "in the shopping mall" and its screenshots predate the November 2025 rework, so treat the mall-floor phrasing in older guides as stale. No power required. If you also hold the IDEA cash register key, the 2 locked TAR2-2 registers in here open too.
cost_per_open.value_note: A meds-and-stims room with no guaranteed container and no LEDX listed - not worth 140,000 roubles when the ULTRA medical storage exists, but absolutely worth carrying if you picked the key up free in Shoreline W101.

cost_per_open.name: Cottage safe key
cost_per_open.opens: The safe on the second floor of the locked cottage/villa on Shoreline
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Inside the LOCKED eastern cottage in the Villas area - you need the Cottage back door key to get in at all. The safe is on the second floor.
cost_per_open.value_note: 141k for one safe behind another locked door is a bad trade at any use count - go get the free one off the seat in the white bus.

cost_per_open.name: Radar station commandant room key
cost_per_open.opens: The radar station commandant's office on the first floor of the radar station on the lighthouse peninsula
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Far SOUTH-WEST of the map on the lighthouse peninsula (map pos ~[377, 309], only ~169 units south-east of the Zryachiy boss spawn — the closest lock on the map to Zryachiy). Enter the radar station building and stay on the first floor; the commandant's office is off the internal corridor. Requires an ENCODED Digital secure DSP radio transmitter to reach the peninsula at all.
cost_per_open.value_note: 144k for a PC block, a 4x4 box and a jacket is bad loot value — buy it once for Top Secret, complete the quest, then resell it. Do not keep it as a farming key.

cost_per_open.name: Real estate agency office room key
cost_per_open.opens: An office on the second floor of the real estate agency
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Real estate agency building. Go up to the second floor; the locked office is off the second-floor landing. The key you need is downstairs in the same building.
cost_per_open.value_note: Do NOT pay ₽150k-275k for this. The key sits in a rack behind the reception desk one floor below the door it opens - walk in, grab it, walk up.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 306 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 306
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, third floor, door marked 306. Up to 3F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: Third-priciest key on the map for a Blue keycard chance, an M4A1 and two dead Scavs - buy it only because Health Care Privacy Part 2 demands it, and check the villa ambulance stretcher first.

cost_per_open.name: USEC cottage first safe key
cost_per_open.opens: The wall safe in the north-western second-floor bedroom of the blue chalet (USEC cottages)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: East side of the map, mid-map, up on the chalet hill (safe at map pos ~[1766, 1534], ~196 units due south of the Path to Shoreline extract and transit). Enter the blue chalet, take the stairs to the second floor, and go to the NORTH-WESTERN bedroom — the safe is on the wall in there. The second safe (different key) is two rooms away in the south-western bedroom, so carry both keys and clear the whole upper floor in one trip. A Goons spawn sits near the blue chalet.
cost_per_open.value_note: Even at the 161k average that is 4,026 rub per open for a four-item high-tech safe worth well over 100k a pop — it pays for itself in one or two opens.

cost_per_open.name: Reshala's bunkhouse key
cost_per_open.opens: Reshala's bunkhouse (his stash) on Customs
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: A cluster of five connected bunkhouse cabins near Stronghold, by the well-known Crackhouse side entrance, between the warehouse building and the buses - it is the second cabin from the right. (Location per community guides; the wiki page gives images only, no text directions.)
cost_per_open.value_note: 4,500 RUB per open for a gun-and-valuables shack - buy it once to clear Accidental Witness, otherwise just kill Reshala, who drops it. Boss spawns now run the rotating red-skull cycle, so farm him on-cycle.

cost_per_open.name: Health Resort west wing room 221 key
cost_per_open.opens: Health Resort west wing room 221, plus rooms 218 and 222 via the shared balconies
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: West wing, second floor, door marked 221. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell. Balconies inside run to 218 and 222.
cost_per_open.value_note: Worst buy on the map: 3.7x the W222 key's price for identical three-room access. If you want it, do the 8x Pack of chlorine barter at Therapist LL2, never pay flea.

cost_per_open.name: Goshan cash register key
cost_per_open.opens: The locked Cash register TAR2-2 units at the Goshan store front (30 of them), plus 3 registers that are locked by mistake on Streets of Tarkov - 2 in the "Shestyorochka" store and 1 in the "Kostin" store.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, Goshan hypermarket on the EAST side of the mall. The checkout bank runs along Goshan's west / north-west frontage facing the central concourse, right where Killa patrols. 30 TAR2-2 units in that bank. No power required.
cost_per_open.value_note: Most registers of the three keys (30) and a Kappa quest gate, so you will buy one regardless; at 200k over 40 uses it is ~5,000 per raid, but since the rouble yield per TAR2-2 is unverified, treat the money-printing claim as unproven.

cost_per_open.name: Object #11SR keycard
cost_per_open.opens: The Saferoom Exfil extraction door in the parking garage. The card is not swiped at the door - it is swiped at a hidden keypad on the second floor, which unlocks and opens the garage door. Inside the Saferoom is also the lever that remotely opens the green TerraGroup Object 14 container elsewhere in the garage.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Two-part. STEP 1, the keypad: second floor of the mall, men's toilet in the "Burger Spot" restaurant on the east side of the second floor. Walk to the urinal and flush it - a keycard panel is revealed behind it. Swipe the card there and a green light comes on. Power must already be on. STEP 2, the actual door: down in the parking garage, on the west side next to parking section C (sections run A at the north end down to D at the south). Walk in, then press the button beside the door to lock it from inside - that locks it and extracts you, and traps any Scav who followed you in. Any PMC who gets there first can loot the room and use the extract.
cost_per_open.value_note: At 52,000 roubles for three weapon boxes, modded M4A1s, the Object 14 lever and a private self-locking extract, it pays for itself in a single raid and is the one key you should never leave home without on Interchange.

cost_per_open.name: Company director's room key
cost_per_open.opens: The company director's room on the second floor of the boiler building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Construction area on the west side of the map, in the boiler building with the two chimneys - up to the second floor, the director's office door.
cost_per_open.value_note: 6,000 RUB per open, but two 5x5 weapon boxes plus an Intelligence folder clears that in one visit - and there are three free spawn points, so farm it rather than buying repeats.

cost_per_open.name: RB-ORB3 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the first barracks armories
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Black Pawn / eastern barracks, north end of the eastern building, 2nd floor - the locked grate door on the side facing Black Bishop (School). Use the northern staircase.
cost_per_open.value_note: 253k for three racks of budget AKs is a scam - the key has four fixed spawns, three of them in White Pawn on your way past, so never buy this one.

cost_per_open.name: Tarbank cash register department key
cost_per_open.opens: Two locked cash-register booths on the first floor of the Tarbank branch
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Tarbank branch on Streets. Enter the main banking hall, get behind the customer counters and turn left - the two locked booths are side by side.
cost_per_open.value_note: Four pure-cash containers per raid across 40 uses - about ₽8k per raid for two 4x4 bank safes and two 3x3 registers. The only key on Streets that reliably prints roubles.

cost_per_open.name: Cardinal apartment key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 2 AND the locked bedroom inside apartment 2, second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex (Kruglov's flat)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Cardinal apartment complex (the luxury block by the Cardinal Apartment Complex Parking scav extract). Go to the second floor - apartment 2's front door and, inside it, the bedroom door both use this same key.
cost_per_open.value_note: Two doors, seven containers and a weapon locker for one key. Free and guaranteed if you run Labs. Note Therapist buys it at flea price - selling it is as good as using it, so only keep it if you actually run Streets.

cost_per_open.name: RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Green)
cost_per_open.opens: The Helicopter extraction — the only extract on Icebreaker for any faction.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The signal flare area on and around the helipad, near the drone hangar. Walking into it pops a bottom-right notification confirming you are in the zone. Fire the flare steeply into the sky — if it does not reach height (or you aim too flat and it lands behind you) the helicopter will not come. Only one member of a lobby-made squad needs to fire it to open the extract for everyone.
cost_per_open.value_note: 7.5k so you do not lose your whole kit on a map where insurance is explicitly void — the highest-return purchase in the game per rouble, and one flare covers the squad.

cost_per_open.name: Kiba Arms outer door key
cost_per_open.opens: The outer door of the KIBA Arms International firearms store. This is the FIRST of two doors - behind it is a grate door that needs the Kiba Arms inner grate door key.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First floor, near the centre of the mall - the KIBA Arms shopfront on the west side of the central crossroads, roughly opposite the Goshan frontage. THE POWER MUST BE ON. About 3 seconds after you open it an alarm starts ringing in the store and across other stores; kill it at the alarm terminal in the security room on the FIRST floor (the second-floor information desk terminal switches off every alarm EXCEPT Kiba, so it does not help you here). Killa patrols this exact crossroads.
cost_per_open.value_note: Only worth buying as half of a ~420,000-rouble pair; at ~10,500 roubles per raid across 40 uses the Kiba haul clears that easily, but a single Kiba key on its own is money set on fire.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PKPTS key
cost_per_open.opens: The technical storeroom in the command part of the underground bunker system
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Command section of the underground bunker (the same area as the D-2 power lever). The technical storeroom door sits to the left of the hermetic door that leads to the flooded room.
cost_per_open.value_note: Priced as a story-progress key rather than a loot key; buy it when The Ticket asks for it, not before.

cost_per_open.name: RB-ORB1 key
cost_per_open.opens: One of the second barracks armories
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: White Pawn / southern barracks, east end of the southern building, 4th floor - the locked grate door on the side facing Black Pawn.
cost_per_open.value_note: The most overpriced key on Reserve - 428k for AK racks and one intel folder. It hangs on a key case in the tunnel shower room; walk there and take it.

cost_per_open.name: Factory emergency exit key
cost_per_open.opens: On Customs: the two doors into the crane yard guard building, and the door leading to the ZB-013 extraction in the Scav base basement. On Factory: the Med Tent Gate extraction, the Cellars extraction and the locked room on the third floor of the office area.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Crane yard guard building sits next to the new gas station - two separate doors, both take this key. The ZB-013 door is in the basement of the Scav base (ZB-013 building); you must also flip the lever in warehouse #4 at the crane yard for that extract to work.
cost_per_open.value_note: 12,000 RUB per open - expensive as a loot key, but it is the only way to open ZB-013, which makes it close to mandatory if you hunt the Goons or run Factory extracts; the loss of the two quest-reward sources is why it costs 240k now.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key
cost_per_open.opens: The laboratory manager office (O21) on the second level. Two separate doors both lead into the same office.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second level, O sector. Cross the bridge/walkway that leads to the glass-walled manager's office suite; a reception desk sits out front (that reception holds a Green keycard spawn next to the keyboard, and a Yellow keycard spawns on the table in front). Either of the two doors opens with the same key.
cost_per_open.value_note: At ~70k for 2 PC blocks, a safe, a 6x3 weapon box, 4 valuables rolls and a free Blue keycard chance this is the best roubles-per-rouble key on the map - just don't pay the 160k spike price.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key
cost_per_open.opens: The laboratory weapon testing area (O11) on the first level. Two separate doors lead into the same room.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: First level, off the big open laboratory hall in the O sector that contains the large orange containment dome - the fenced/glassed shooting range on the east side of that hall. Both doors work. The Transit to Streets of Tarkov and the Preliminary Survey quest laptop are both by the same dome, so this is a very fast in-and-out.
cost_per_open.value_note: ~72k for a guaranteed 5x5 plus a 4x4 weapon box on the first level next to the transit is the cheapest reliable weapon-crate room in the game, and it gates a Lightkeeper objective.

cost_per_open.name: Concordia apartment 64 key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 64 (the premium apartment) on the second floor of the Concordia building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Concordia. Take the HOUSE NO. 3 staircase to the second floor; apartment 64's front door is off that hallway.
cost_per_open.value_note: Wildly overpriced for a flat with loose loot and one COFDM. The 40 uses soften it but at ₽650,000-940,000 with no quest attached this is speculation, not looting.

cost_per_open.name: Shared bedroom marked key
cost_per_open.opens: The marked shared bedroom on the second floor of the house next to the guard building, on the lighthouse peninsula
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Far SOUTH-WEST of the map on the lighthouse peninsula (map pos ~[661, 104], ~518 units south-east of the Zryachiy boss spawn). Cross the bridge to the peninsula, find the house immediately NEXT TO the guard building, take the internal staircase to the second floor — the marked bedroom door is up there. HARD GATE: the bridge is full of claymores and guarded by Zryachiy; you need an ENCODED Digital secure DSP radio transmitter (Network Provider / Getting Acquainted questline) to pass. If any member of a lobby-made group lacks an encoded transmitter, the whole group is blocked.
cost_per_open.value_note: Highest-EV room on Lighthouse — all six Labs keycards, a Red Rebel and every container case in the game roll here — but 10 uses at 240k-486k is 24k-49k per open and it is useless until you have peninsula access, so it is an endgame buy, not an S-tier auto-buy.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm overseer key
cost_per_open.opens: The overseer's room between rooms 209 and 211 on the second floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, second floor - the unnumbered door sandwiched between doors 209 and 211.
cost_per_open.value_note: Only 2 uses, so ~29.5k per open - but a full PMC body plus a rare gun and a Slick or Hexgrid clears that in one hit; farm the guaranteed Shoreline smugglers' base spawn instead of buying.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow)
cost_per_open.opens: The parking garage alarm system control room on the second level. Inside is the keyboard that disables the announcement triggered by activating the "Parking Gate" extraction.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second level, on the parking/Y side - south of Kruglov's office and the Y21 Parking Gate button room, sitting between the R22 admin block and the cafeteria (R24) run. Small single door off the corridor.
cost_per_open.value_note: Cheapest colour card that still holds a weapon safe, a PC block and a Red keycard roll, and Therapist hands back 178,500₽ - the best low-budget colour card even though the room is small.

cost_per_open.name: Elektronik's key
cost_per_open.opens: Apartment 2 on the first floor of the Klimova 14A building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Klimova 14A. The entrance is on the BACKYARD side; apartment 2 is on the ground floor just inside.
cost_per_open.value_note: One drawer and some food. Never buy this on the flea - Mechanic barters it for a single Bitcoin and the quest hands you one for free.

cost_per_open.name: Aspect company office key
cost_per_open.opens: The front door of the "Aspect" LLC company building (56 Primorsky Ave)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Front entrance door of the Aspect LLC building. You do not need it - the building has a hole in the wall on the BACK side. The only benefit is entering from the front without crossing Kaban's guards on the NSV and AGS emplacements.
cost_per_open.value_note: ₽35,000-63,000 for ONE use of a door you can bypass through a hole in the back wall. There is no loot behind it. Never buy this - just sell the ones Kaban drops.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup Labs arsenal storage room key
cost_per_open.opens: The storage room door INSIDE the laboratory security arsenal (R23). You must already be through the Red keycard door to use it.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Second level, security wing. Once you are inside the Red arsenal, the storage room door is on the interior wall of that room.
cost_per_open.value_note: You need a Red keycard just to reach the door and the payoff is one drawer plus loose mods - 250k+ for a side closet is the worst value on the map; farm it free on Customs if you want it at all.

cost_per_open.name: Dorm room 314 marked key
cost_per_open.opens: Room 314, the Marked Room, on the third floor of the three-storey dorms
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Three-storey dorms, third floor. Easiest approach is the stairs on the south side of the building straight up to floor three. The door is unmistakable - ritual markings, scratched symbols and candles around it.
cost_per_open.value_note: 60k per open for the best loose-loot room in the game - one keycard or one container pays for the whole key; also note Therapist buys it back at 765k, above the current flea ask.

cost_per_open.name: Chekannaya 15 apartment key
cost_per_open.opens: The easternmost apartment on the second floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building (the jail warden's flat)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Chekannaya 15, and this is a genuinely awkward route. Enter through the marked hole in the exterior wall, reach the WESTERN staircase, go up to the THIRD floor, then drop through the hole in the floor of prison cell #5 to land on the second floor. The second-floor hallway is blocked by debris you can only pass by PRONING. The door is the last one on the east end.
cost_per_open.value_note: ₽1.3M for multi-Bitcoin and a COFDM is roughly break-even at best, and House Arrest eats one outright. Buy exactly the number you need for the quests and no more.

cost_per_open.name: Shturman's stash key
cost_per_open.opens: The Common fund stash - Shturman's personal 5x5 locked loot container in the sawmill
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Dead centre-south of the map at the Old Sawmill. The crate sits on top of a tyre next to the stacked wood-log pile in the sawmill yard. Interactive-map data puts it roughly 15-20 m from Shturman's own spawn point, so you are inside his and his 2-3 guards' sightlines the whole time you loot it. Approach behind the log stacks, loot it late in the raid, and expect a Violet keycard SUV spawn and a 5x2 weapon box within ~15 m.
cost_per_open.value_note: Free and excellent if you were already hunting Shturman on his red-skull cycle; paying 80k for a 1-use key you then have to walk to his front porch to use is a coin flip, not a plan.

cost_per_open.name: Mysterious room marked key
cost_per_open.opens: The marked room on the first floor of the Chekannaya 13 apartment building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Chekannaya 13 (NOT 15 - there is no "Chekannaya 13 key" page; this key is the Chek. 13 key). Enter the building through a window from the courtyard, get into the corridor, take the second room on the left, go through the hole in the wall in that bedroom, then head downstairs and the marked-room door is on your left.
cost_per_open.value_note: Same jackpot pool as the factory marked room plus a LEDX, and roughly a quarter the price on the cheaper source. If you only buy one marked key on Streets, buy this one.

cost_per_open.name: Relaxation room key
cost_per_open.opens: The "Hive" hookah lounge in the Malevicha Street no. 5 building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Malevicha street no. 5 building. The Hive hookah lounge door is on the ground level of that building - a single obvious locked door.
cost_per_open.value_note: Great room, terrible purchase: ₽180k+ for TWO opens. It spawns free and guaranteed in Zmeisky 6 every raid - farm it, never buy it. (It is also a Cultist Circle sacrifice that yields a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine.)

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup science office key
cost_per_open.opens: Office no. 4 on the second floor of the TerraGroup main building. Marked on the wiki interactive map as "TerraGroup Science Office" under the Locked category. IMPORTANT BYPASS: the wiki's own Notes section states the office can also be entered through the internal window from the adjacent office no. 3 by climbing onto the window sill, with no key at all. Office no. 3 is not locked.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The TerraGroup complex is business centre Area 3, east-central on the map, immediately north of the Police Cordon V-Ex and east of the central park. Enter the main building's ground-floor lobby and take the lobby stairs (on the right-hand side as you face the big white diamond TerraGroup logo) up to the second floor. On the second floor the offices are numbered in large white painted numerals directly on the bare concrete wall. Door 4 is the plain white door under the big painted "4", with a stack of blue water-cooler bottles on the floor to its left and a low planter box of green plants to its right; a large blue-and-purple video wall glows on the ceiling/wall above the open floor beyond. Door 3 is the immediately adjacent door to the left, with its own painted "3". If you have no key, go into 3 and climb the internal window sill through into 4.
cost_per_open.value_note: Do not buy this. ~115-125k roubles for ONE use, opening a room worth three PC blocks and four drawers, when a guaranteed free copy spawns on the lab technician body every raid downstairs in the same building and you can climb through the window from office 3 without any key whatsoever — this is the single biggest rouble trap on Ground Zero.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup Labs access keycard
cost_per_open.opens: The Lab itself. Consumed at the deployment screen as the entry fee for the map; it is not a door key.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: No door - it is the map's entry toll, requested on The Lab map-selection screen. The Lab is initially reachable only by Transit (from Streets of Tarkov or Factory); direct deployment unlocks after you progress the story chapter Tour. Every member of a group needs their own card.
cost_per_open.value_note: Mandatory tax on playing the map - craft it at Intelligence Center 2 for ~58k instead of paying 119k on flea and you halve your entry cost overnight.

cost_per_open.name: TerraGroup Labs access keycard
cost_per_open.opens: The 'Transit to The Lab' gate on Factory (and the Lab map-selection screen generally). Consumed on entry.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: In the sewer tunnel connected to the flooded area of the Factory underground. It only becomes available 1 minute after raid start, it is PMC-only, and every living member of a group needs their own card to transit together.
cost_per_open.value_note: Buy it from Therapist LL3 at ~P51k and never off the flea at ~P119k - it is a Lab ticket that happens to be redeemable from Factory, so only carry one on a raid where you actually intend to transit.

cost_per_open.name: Grumpy's hideout key
cost_per_open.opens: Grumpy's hideout, a hidden Arena-gladiator stash room inside the power station.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Inside the power station building in the NORTH-EAST corner of the map (the building with the power switch, next to the Powerstation V-Ex). Enter the main turbine hall and head to the far SOUTH-WEST corner of the hall - a padlocked door leads into a small side-room block beside the stairwell. The power switch itself is on the north wall of the same hall, and the basement stairs down to ARRS Station 14-4 KORD are in the same building, so this is a one-stop building.
cost_per_open.value_note: Best loot density on Interchange and a Green keycard spawn, but 5 uses against a ~900,000-rouble Arena-currency barter means it only pays if the Green keycard or a top-tier helmet actually rolls - a luxury pick, not a staple.

cost_per_open.name: RB-BK marked key
cost_per_open.opens: The marked room in the Black Pawn barracks (eastern barracks)
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Black Pawn / eastern barracks building near the parked helicopter. The wiki lock page places the marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building, while the Semiconductor Crisis page describes the same room as being in the basement of black pawn - enter the north-east front door and work down to the lowest level of that wing. Look for the scratched symbols on the door.
cost_per_open.value_note: At 200-400k per door open this is a gamble, not a loot route - but it is usually the cheapest of the three Reserve marked keys and it clears two story chapters, so it is the one to buy if you buy any.

cost_per_open.name: SZ-1 explosive charge (Icebreaker)
cost_per_open.opens: The chain on the damaged door on level 3, on the roof of the engine room — the only documented way into the icebreaker superstructure.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Start at the helicopter extract zone but do not extract. Go two levels down, take the stairs on the left after leaving the drone hangar, loop around the helipad, continue all the way out to the side of the ship, then climb to level 3. The damaged door is chained shut; place the charge on the chain. Expect one Black Division group on the helipad and another underneath it, and a teargas tripwire on the quarters' entrance door on the far side.
cost_per_open.value_note: 212k for a one-shot consumable stings, but it is the only door into the superstructure and it pays for itself the first run because it opens the chain that leads to the ~382k C-1 card, the crew quarters card and the C-3 lab.

cost_per_open.name: Labrys access keycard
cost_per_open.opens: The Labyrinth itself - it is the transit ticket consumed when you take the Shoreline transit into the map. Not an in-map door.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Shoreline, Health Resort WEST wing, basement. Go down into the west wing basement; the transit door is at the end of the basement corridor (the Knossos LLC door). The Knossos LLC facility key unlocks that door; the keycard is then consumed by the transit terminal behind it.
cost_per_open.value_note: Mandatory and consumed every single raid - this is the map's real cost of entry, so treat ~400k of barter goods (or one home-brewed moonshine) as the price of admission, not as a key purchase.

cost_per_open.name: RB-PKPM marked key
cost_per_open.opens: The marked room next to the command office in the underground tunnel system
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Underground tunnel / bunker system. Find the command office (the room with the D-2 power lever); the marked room is the door immediately next to it.

cost_per_open.name: RB-VO marked key
cost_per_open.opens: The marked room in the security / guard barracks building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: The security (guard) barracks in the north-west of the map - the same building that holds the RB-AO armoury, whose door is visible from inside this marked room. Look for the scratched symbols.

cost_per_open.name: Car dealership closed section key
cost_per_open.opens: The grate door to the closed section on the second floor of the LexOs car dealership
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: LexOs car dealership (Kaban's building). Get to the second-floor showroom level; the closed section is behind a metal grate/fenced door on that floor.
cost_per_open.value_note: Six containers is a great room but ₽520,000 for ONE open is a terrible buy. Kill Kaban on his red-skull cycle - he has a high chance to be carrying it - or sell yours to Therapist for nearly the same money.

cost_per_open.name: Abandoned factory marked key
cost_per_open.opens: The marked room on the third floor of the NORTHERN abandoned factory building
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Abandoned factory complex. Go into the northern factory building (it also has a basement entrance) and climb to the third floor - the marked room is visible from the second-floor staircase landing before you reach it.
cost_per_open.value_note: The best loot pool on the map, but at a ₽1.5M baseline that is ~₽150k per open for a lottery ticket. Buy for the quests, not for profit - and never buy during a price spike.

cost_per_open.name: Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint
cost_per_open.opens: The port garrison intercom on Shoreline - grants one single entry to Terminal. This is the SURVIVOR ending access item. Note: for this one you press the intercom CALL button rather than swiping a card.
cost_per_open.where_is_the_door: Not on Terminal - the lock is the port garrison intercom in the watchtower at Shoreline's south-eastern port checkpoint. Use the intercom call button between 21:00 and 06:00, then take the LEFT road to the transit zone.
cost_per_open.value_note: Five million roubles for one entry and no lootable payoff, but it is the only Terminal access item you can buy outright with cash and it is repeatable twice per reset - the pragmatic re-run ticket.

Physical Bitcoin.key: Unity Credit Bank cash register key
Physical Bitcoin.where: The Tarbank is tenant no. 1 of the Empire business centre (Area 5), on the west face of the Empire block facing ул. Норвинская (Norvinskaya Street), just south of the ул. Торговый ряд junction and directly across the street from the Fusion block / "Coffie Vice" corner. It sits roughly map-centre, west-southwest of the TerraGroup complex and south-west of the Police Cordon V-Ex. Go in through the Tarbank customer hall, then into the staff corridor behind the teller line — a plain white corridor with a dark grey wainscot stripe running along the walls. Booth 2's door is on the right-hand side of that corridor, the middle door of the run; further down the corridor on the left there is an open doorway with cardboard boxes stacked in it, which is a good landmark. Торговый ряд junction and directly across the street from the Fusion block / "Coffie Vice" corner. It sits roughly map-centre, west-southwest of the TerraGroup complex and south-west of the Police Cordon V-Ex. Go in through the Tarbank customer hall, then into the staff corridor behind the teller line — a plain white corridor with a dark grey wainscot stripe running along the walls. Booth 2's door is on the right-hand side of that corridor, the middle door of the run; further down the corridor on the left there is an open doorway with cardboard boxes stacked in it, which is a good landmark. Inside is a single tiny teller cubicle: desk with monitor, keyboard, mouse and a desk phone, a wooden-framed glazed serving window onto the customer hall, a combination safe built in under the counter on the left, and a three-drawer filing unit with a printer on top to the right.

Enter the building through a window from the courtyard, get into the corridor, take the second room on the left, go through the hole in the wall in that bedroom, then head downstairs and the marked-room door is on your left.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Grumpy's hideout key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: Inside the power station building in the NORTH-EAST corner of the map (the building with the power switch, next to the Powerstation V-Ex). Enter the main turbine hall and head to the far SOUTH-WEST corner of the hall - a padlocked door leads into a small side-room block beside the stairwell. The power switch itself is on the north wall of the same hall, and the basement stairs down to ARRS Station 14-4 KORD are in the same building, so this is a one-stop building.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Abandoned factory marked key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: Abandoned factory complex. Go into the northern factory building (it also has a basement entrance) and climb to the third floor - the marked room is visible from the second-floor staircase landing before you reach it.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Voron's hideout key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: Inside the hydroelectric power station building (the same structure that holds the HEP station USEC stash and where the E222 and E328 keys spawn). The hideout door is a separate locked room within the station - not in the resort at all, so plan a dedicated route.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Leon's hideout key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: Far EAST of the map, mid-map (map pos ~[2087, 1800], ~265 units east of the Path to Shoreline extract and ~300 units north-east of the blue chalet garage). It is the big village house on the eastern edge; the hideout door is on the second floor. The in-game description calling it 'next to the bridge that leads to the water treatment plant' is flavour text and misleading — navigate off the Path to Shoreline extract instead.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Shatun's hideout key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: Eastern side of Woods, in the eastern village, well north of the train depot and south-west of the Bridge V-Ex. It is one of the village houses; the hideout door is on the ground floor. Once inside, the Yellow keycard is tucked into the right-hand side of the sofa. A sports bag sits right at the door, two more are on the second floor of the same building, and there are four toolboxes within ~30 m outside. A Scav spawn sits ~15 m away.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Health Resort west wing room 325 key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: West wing, third floor, room 325. Door is open. Still worth entering for the Blue keycard spawn.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Health Resort west wing room 303 key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: West wing, third floor, room 303. Door is open - and there is still a reason to go, because the room holds a TerraGroup Labs Yellow keycard spawn location.

TerraGroup Labs keycard.key: Health Resort west wing room 221 key
TerraGroup Labs keycard.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 221. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell. Balconies inside run to 218 and 222.

weapon box.where: Far west / south-west of Woods, against the western map border. From the sawmill head south to the big lake, then west with the lake on your left, continue to the large cliff face and follow it until you see a white fence - the concrete bunker is sunk into the ground along that fence, roughly north of the Scav House extract and south of the Power Line Passage flare zone. Go down the entrance stairs; the locked grate door is at the bottom inside the bunker. Thick green smoke behind the door means the exfil is live; with no smoke the door still opens, you just cannot extract. Watch the rocks nearby, known camping spot.

Underground level, in the parking/loading branch of the underground corridor network near the Skyside (Area 2) stairwell — the western half of the underground, reachable from the surface by the vehicle ramp that drops down into the parking deck. Drive/run down the ramp; the ramp has a raised pedestrian walkway on the left-hand (building) side. As the ramp bottoms out onto the parking level, look at that left wall: it is black-tiled and carries two red-and-white Russian signs, "ВНИМАНИЕ! ОБЪЕКТ ОХРАНЯЕТСЯ / ВЕДЁТСЯ ВИДЕОНАБЛЮДЕНИЕ" (CCTV warning) above "ПОСТОРОННИМ ВХОД ВОСПРЕЩЁН" (no unauthorised entry). Directly under those signs a short flight of concrete steps with a metal handrail drops into a sunken stairwell. The plain grey metal door at the bottom of those steps is the utility room. There is a raised loading walkway stacked with cardboard boxes on your right as you face the steps, and pickup trucks/vans parked behind a chain-link fence beyond it.

Second floor of the hydroelectric power station building (away from the resort - the same station where the E222 and E328 keys spawn and where Voron's hideout is). There are two different doors that this key opens, and each one consumes a point of durability, so decide up front whether you need both.

Same building as the toilet key, far south-east of the map at the train depot: the small old house with semi-circle windows, ~2 m from the toilet door (the room door is the north-west one of the pair). Two buried barrel caches sit within about 10-15 m of the house and a Scav spawn is ~25 m away. Route in is the BTR to the Train Depot stop; the street out front is in border-sniper reach, so stay tight to the wall.

Outside, NORTH-EAST of the mall: the fenced electrical substation compound beside the power station and the Powerstation V-Ex. The cabin is the small prefab shack inside that compound - a short detour from the power switch you already have to flip, which is what makes this key worth its price. No power required to open it.
Construction/factory zone - the stacked portable cabins across from the bus depot; the door is on the upper cabin, reached by the external stairs.

Western edge of the water treatment plant (map pos ~[997, 2571], ~217 units north of the WTP southern AGS-30 emplacement, ~314 units north-east of the Scav Hideout at the Grotto scav extract). It is the standalone cabin right next to the police truck — the two locks are only ~75 units apart, so always carry both keys together.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 316 key
weapon box.where: East wing, third floor, door marked 316. Central Administration or east wing stairwell to 3F, then along the east corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 313 key
weapon box.where: East wing, third floor, door marked 313. Central Administration or east wing stairwell up to 3F, then along the east corridor. Balcony inside connects to 314.

South-west of the map at the repair centre. Go to the bigger of the two garage buildings at the white knight repair point; the locked door is inside the garage bay (also visible/approachable from outside the garages). This is the room that holds the third BMP-2.
Two-storey dorms, ground floor, immediately to the right of the front entrance. Single locked door off the entrance hall.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 314 key
weapon box.where: East wing, third floor, door marked 314. Central Administration or east wing stairwell to 3F, along the east corridor. Balcony inside links to 313.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 206 key
weapon box.where: East wing, second floor, door marked 206. Up to 2F by the central Administration or east wing stairwell and along the east corridor. Balcony inside links to 205.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 216 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 216. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor. No balcony partner - this is a single room.
2nd floor of the western repair point building (black knight per the wiki), in the south-west repair complex.

Far SOUTH-WEST of the map on the lighthouse peninsula (map pos ~[668, 38], ~567 units south-east of the Zryachiy boss spawn, at the very southern tip). Enter the peninsula guard building, take the internal stairs to the second floor; the conference room door is off the landing. Same claymore/Zryachiy gate as the other two peninsula keys — you need an ENCODED Digital secure DSP radio transmitter.

Water treatment plant, north of the map (map pos ~[1455, 2785], ~238 units south-east of the WTP Goons spawn and ~283 units south of the Industrial Zone Gates scav extract). Office building #3 is the eastern WTP office block. On the first floor, go to the SOUTHWEST corner — that is the barrack door.
New gas station on the east side of the map - go inside, down the hallway, last room on the right at the end.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 205 key
weapon box.where: East wing, second floor, door marked 205. Up to 2F by the central Administration or east wing stairwell. Balcony inside links to 206.
The container yard between the LexOs car dealership and the car repair workshop. Walk into the shipping container; the mesh/grate door partitions off the closed rear section.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 306 key
weapon box.where: East wing, third floor. Up the central Administration stairwell or the east wing stairwell to 3F, then along the east corridor to the door marked 306. The balcony inside links straight into 308, so this one key clears both rooms.

Outside the mall, to the SOUTH-WEST, in the shipping-container lot between the mall and the highway. Look for the single RED TerraGroup container stacked on top of other containers - the card panel is on its door, and you have to get up onto the stack to reach it. THE POWER MUST BE ON. This is well away from the mall fighting, so it is a safe first or last stop depending on your spawn.
Warehouse #6, over by the fuel silos near the ZB-1011 bunker extract - ground floor, the storage room off the main floor (the warehouse with the green screen room).

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 220 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 220. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.

weapon box.key: Kiba Arms inner grate door key
weapon box.where: First floor, centre of the mall: a couple of metres inside the KIBA Arms outer door, on the west side of the central crossroads opposite Goshan. You cannot reach it without first opening the outer door with the Kiba Arms outer door key (which needs power and trips the alarm). The grate door itself does not need power.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 222 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor. Up to 2F via the central Administration stairwell or the west wing stairwell, then along the west corridor to the door marked 222. From inside, the balconies connect to both 221 and 218, so this single door gets you a three-room sweep.
TerraGroup security post building. Enter the main door, follow the interior corridor past the reception; the armory is the heavy door at the end of that route on the ground floor.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 226 key
weapon box.where: East wing, second floor, door marked 226 - near the 227 end of the 2F east corridor. Reach 2F by the central Administration stairwell or the east wing stairwell. Once in, the shared balcony (which itself holds a weapon locker) runs across into 222.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 203 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 203. Up either the central Administration stairwell or the west wing stairwell to 2F and along the west corridor. The balcony inside opens into 205.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 222 key
weapon box.where: East wing, second floor, door marked 222. Up the central Administration or east wing stairwell to 2F and along the east corridor. Balcony inside links to 226; the balcony itself has a weapon locker.
White Pawn / southern barracks, east end of the southern building, 2nd floor - the locked grate door on the side facing Black Pawn.

Two-part. STEP 1, the keypad: second floor of the mall, men's toilet in the "Burger Spot" restaurant on the east side of the second floor. Walk to the urinal and flush it - a keycard panel is revealed behind it. Swipe the card there and a green light comes on. Power must already be on. STEP 2, the actual door: down in the parking garage, on the west side next to parking section C (sections run A at the north end down to D at the south). Walk in, then press the button beside the door to lock it from inside - that locks it and extracts you, and traps any Scav who followed you in. Any PMC who gets there first can loot the room and use the extract.

The southern-most small building at the foot of the radio/radar tower, i.e. the guard building just outside the radar station on the western path. There are two lockable doors on the shack and RB-KPRL opens both.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 308 key

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 205 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 205. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell. Balcony inside links to 203.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 218 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 218. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell, then along the west corridor. Balconies inside run to both 221 and 222.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 219 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 219. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell and along the west corridor. Single room, no balcony partner.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 301 key
weapon box.where: West wing, third floor. Take the central Administration glass stairwell or the west wing's own stairwell up to 3F and walk the west corridor until you see 301 painted above the door. Once inside, go out onto the balcony and cut into 304 - there is no W304 key, so this door is the only way into the best room on the floor.

Far SOUTH-WEST of the map on the lighthouse peninsula (map pos ~[377, 309], only ~169 units south-east of the Zryachiy boss spawn — the closest lock on the map to Zryachiy). Enter the radar station building and stay on the first floor; the commandant's office is off the internal corridor. Requires an ENCODED Digital secure DSP radio transmitter to reach the peninsula at all.
Construction area on the west side of the map, in the boiler building with the two chimneys - up to the second floor, the director's office door.

weapon box.key: TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key
weapon box.where: First level, off the big open laboratory hall in the O sector that contains the large orange containment dome - the fenced/glassed shooting range on the east side of that hall. Both doors work. The Transit to Streets of Tarkov and the Preliminary Survey quest laptop are both by the same dome, so this is a very fast in-and-out.

weapon box.key: TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key
weapon box.where: Second level, O sector. Cross the bridge/walkway that leads to the glass-walled manager's office suite; a reception desk sits out front (that reception holds a Green keycard spawn next to the keyboard, and a Yellow keycard spawns on the table in front). Either of the two doors opens with the same key.
LexOs car dealership (Kaban's building). Get to the second-floor showroom level; the closed section is behind a metal grate/fenced door on that floor.

Abandoned factory complex. Go into the northern factory building (it also has a basement entrance) and climb to the third floor - the marked room is visible from the second-floor staircase landing before you reach it.

Second level, medical/G wing at the north end of the map. Follow the level-2 corridor north out of the O/R sectors; the Green double glass doors sit at the end, and Sanitar's blue-marking door is directly in front of them. The Cargo Elevator extract is on the same level opposite room G21.

Second level, the same security corner as the Red arsenal - the Violet door sits diagonally across the small lobby from the Red arsenal door, a few metres further along the shelf hallway. Approach from Kruglov's office / the Y21 Parking Gate room and walk the hallway to its very end.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 209 key
weapon box.where: East wing, second floor, room 209. Door is open. Its balcony also connects to 213, which is likewise permanently unlocked, so the whole pair is a free walk-in.

weapon box.key: Health Resort east wing room 213 key
weapon box.where: East wing, second floor, room 213. Door is open, and the balcony connects to 209 which is also open.

weapon box.key: Health Resort west wing room 221 key
weapon box.where: West wing, second floor, door marked 221. Up to 2F by the central Administration or west wing stairwell. Balconies inside run to 218 and 222.

Red Rebel.where: Far SOUTH-WEST of the map on the lighthouse peninsula (map pos ~[661, 104], ~518 units south-east of the Zryachiy boss spawn). Cross the bridge to the peninsula, find the house immediately NEXT TO the guard building, take the internal staircase to the second floor — the marked bedroom door is up there. HARD GATE: the bridge is full of claymores and guarded by Zryachiy; you need an ENCODED Digital secure DSP radio transmitter (Network Provider / Getting Acquainted questline) to pass. If any member of a lobby-made group lacks an encoded transmitter, the whole group is blocked.

Dead centre-south of the map at the Old Sawmill. The crate sits on top of a tyre next to the stacked wood-log pile in the sawmill yard. Interactive-map data puts it roughly 15-20 m from Shturman's own spawn point, so you are inside his and his 2-3 guards' sightlines the whole time you loot it. Approach behind the log stacks, loot it late in the raid, and expect a Violet keycard SUV spawn and a 5x2 weapon box within ~15 m.

Chekannaya 13 (NOT 15 - there is no "Chekannaya 13 key" page; this key is the Chek. 13 key). Enter the building through a window from the courtyard, get into the corridor, take the second room on the left, go through the hole in the wall in that bedroom, then head downstairs and the marked-room door is on your left.

Black Pawn / eastern barracks building near the parked helicopter. The wiki lock page places the marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building, while the Semiconductor Crisis page describes the same room as being in the basement of black pawn - enter the north-east front door and work down to the lowest level of that wing. Look for the scratched symbols on the door.
Underground tunnel / bunker system. Find the command office (the room with the D-2 power lever); the marked room is the door immediately next to it.
The security (guard) barracks in the north-west of the map - the same building that holds the RB-AO armoury, whose door is visible from inside this marked room. Look for the scratched symbols.

Abandoned factory complex. Go into the northern factory building (it also has a basement entrance) and climb to the third floor - the marked room is visible from the second-floor staircase landing before you reach it.

Far EAST of the map, mid-map (map pos ~[2087, 1800], ~265 units east of the Path to Shoreline extract and ~300 units north-east of the blue chalet garage). Take the west-side staircase to the 2nd floor; the storage room door is at the top on that side. Bypass: you can also reach the room with no key at all by dropping from a 3rd-floor window onto the door awning and climbing in through the room's window.

Pinewood hotel, northern building. Use the northern entrance and go to the second floor; room 215 is along that corridor. (The Pinewood Basement co-op extract is in the north-eastern staircase of the same hotel.)

Shoreline, Health Resort WEST wing, basement. Go down into the west wing basement; the transit door is at the end of the basement corridor (the Knossos LLC door). The Knossos LLC facility key unlocks that door; the keycard is then consumed by the transit terminal behind it.

WEST-CENTRAL inner labyrinth, about 19 m due WEST of the observation-room door. It is the walled-off dead-end room on the north side of the west-central corridor; the door is on the room's EAST face and community maps label it 'CORPSE ROOM' with a padlock. Coming from The Way Up, head west/south-west past the observation room and it is the sealed room on your right.

Ophthalmoscope.where: White Bishop (HQ / hospital) building, 2nd floor. It is one of the two locked medical doors up there - the other is RB-KSM.

Shoreline, Health Resort WEST wing, basement. Go down into the west wing basement; the transit door is at the end of the basement corridor (the Knossos LLC door). The Knossos LLC facility key unlocks that door; the keycard is then consumed by the transit terminal behind it.

Inside the hydroelectric power station building (the same structure that holds the HEP station USEC stash and where the E222 and E328 keys spawn). The hideout door is a separate locked room within the station - not in the resort at all, so plan a dedicated route.

Second level, medical/G wing - the door standing directly in front of the laboratory block (G22) Green double doors. You reach both off the same north corridor, so plan to hit Sanitar's room and the Green room in one loop.

Three-storey dorms, second floor - the unnumbered door sandwiched between doors 209 and 211.
